metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .claude directory.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供一组面向真实工程场景的 AI 编码代理技能模板，强调小而可组合、跨模型适配与可自定义流程。其核心价值在于通过需求追问、共享术语和任务约束，修复代理误解、冗长输出与流程失控等常见问题，适合团队协作、需求澄清和工程交付提效。
summary.en: This repository packages a set of practical skills for AI coding agents aimed at real software engineering rather than prompt-only experimentation. Its main value is improving agent reliability through composable workflows for requirement grilling, shared project language, and controllable execution. The skills are model-agnostic, easy to adapt, and designed to reduce misalignment, verbosity, and process brittleness in team collaboration, ticket-driven development, and day-to-day engineering delivery.

metadata.name: gsap-skills
metadata.description: Official AI skills for GSAP. These skills teach AI coding agents how to correctly use GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), including best practices, common animation patterns, and plugin usage.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供官方 GSAP AI Skills，以 Agent Skills 规范为 Claude、Cursor、Copilot 等编码代理注入动画开发知识。内容覆盖时间线、ScrollTrigger、Flip、MotionPath 及 React/Vue/Svelte 集成，强调正确 API 用法、性能优化与插件实践，适用于生成高质量网页动画代码。
summary.en: This repository delivers official GSAP AI Skills in the Agent Skills format, giving coding agents structured knowledge for building web animations correctly. It covers the core GSAP API, timelines, ScrollTrigger, Flip, MotionPath, plugin usage, framework integration across React, Vue, Svelte, and vanilla JavaScript, plus performance best practices. Its main value is improving the reliability and quality of AI-generated animation code across multiple developer agents and coding environments.

metadata.name: guizang-social-card-skill
metadata.description: 🪧 Claude Code / Codex skill — generate Xiaohongshu carousels & WeChat 21:9+1:1 cover pairs. Editorial × Swiss visual systems, 28 layouts, 10 themes, single-file HTML → PNG. 小红书图文 + 公众号封面对

summary.zh: 该仓库面向 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体，提供社交卡片生成技能，可将文章、截图、照片与产品笔记快速转为小红书组图及公众号 21:9+1:1 封面。其核心亮点是双视觉系统、28 套版式骨架、单文件 HTML 到 PNG 渲染，以及内置图源抓取、版式校验与截图美化工作流。
summary.en: This repository is an agent-oriented social card generation skill for Claude Code, Codex, and similar environments. It turns articles, screenshots, photos, product notes, and captions into Xiaohongshu carousels and matched WeChat 21:9 plus 1:1 cover pairs. Its main strengths are two distinct visual systems, 28 reusable layout skeletons, single-file HTML-to-PNG rendering, and a practical workflow that includes image sourcing, layout validation, map components, and screenshot presentation assets without requiring a frontend build pipeline.

metadata.name: GEOFlow
metadata.description: Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system with AI tasks, RAG/semantic chunking, analytics, GEOFlow Agent and WordPress target publishing.

summary.zh: GEOFlow是一套面向生成式引擎优化的开源内容工程平台，打通知识库、RAG切片、AI生成、审核发布与多站点分发，支持WordPress、HTTP API和Agent站点包，适合团队持续运营可追踪的内容资产。
summary.en: GEOFlow is an open-source content engineering and multi-site distribution platform built for Generative Engine Optimization. It connects knowledge bases, semantic chunking, RAG retrieval, prompt and asset management, AI generation workflows, review and publishing, and centralized analytics into one operational pipeline. The system supports OpenAI-compatible and Gemini models, and distributes content through WordPress REST, generic HTTP APIs, and GEOFlow Agent site packages. It is well suited for teams that need scalable, auditable, and reusable content operations across multiple publishing endpoints.

metadata.name: next-ai-draw-io
metadata.description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 图表生成与编辑应用，将自然语言交互与 draw.io 深度结合，支持创建、修改和增强架构图、流程图及可视化草图。项目亮点在于多模型接入、实时图形生成、网页与桌面多端部署，以及面向技术设计和知识表达的高效可视化工作流。
summary.en: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js application that combines large language models with draw.io to generate, refine, and enhance diagrams through natural language. It supports architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and lightweight visual sketches, making diagram creation faster for engineering design, documentation, and idea communication. Its main strengths are AI-assisted visual editing, multi-provider model integration, and flexible deployment across web, desktop, Docker, and edge platforms, giving teams a practical workflow for turning prompts into structured visual outputs.

metadata.name: syber-gpt-image-2
metadata.description: syber-gpt-image-2

summary.zh: 该项目是面向 gpt-image-2 的图像生成服务，采用 React 前端与 FastAPI 后端，集成文生图、改图、提示词优化、异步任务、历史记录与账单管理。其亮点在于兼容 sub2api 的 OpenAI 接口，支持游客与注册用户双模式、多参考图编辑、管理员动态配置上游服务，并提供适合生产环境的 Docker Compose 部署方案。
summary.en: This repository provides a production-oriented image generation service built with React and FastAPI around the gpt-image-2 model. It supports text-to-image, image editing, prompt optimization, async task tracking, history, billing, and both guest and authenticated user modes. Its main strengths are OpenAI-compatible sub2api integration, multi-reference image editing, dynamic upstream configuration for admins, and a deployment design tailored for Docker Compose and real-world self-hosted operation.

metadata.name: llm-wiki-agent
metadata.description: A personal knowledge base that builds and maintains itself. Drop in sources — Claude (or Codex/Gemini) reads them, extracts knowledge, and maintains a persistent interlinked wiki. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI. No API key needed.

summary.zh: 该项目把大模型代理变成可持续运转的个人知识库引擎：将 Markdown、PDF、Office 等资料投入后，自动抽取实体与概念，沉淀为可持续演化的互链 Wiki，并生成知识图谱、矛盾标注与综合结论。其亮点是零 API Key、兼容多种 CLI 智能体，并支持跨源持续增量更新。
summary.en: LLM Wiki Agent turns an LLM coding agent into a self-maintaining personal knowledge base. Users drop in Markdown, PDF, Office, HTML, or other source files, and the agent ingests them into a persistent interlinked wiki with entity pages, concept pages, source summaries, contradiction flags, and synthesized overviews. It also builds a reusable knowledge graph for exploration. Key strengths are its agent-native workflow, no API key requirement, broad document format support, and compatibility with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and similar local or CLI-based agent environments.

metadata.name: Image-Studio
metadata.description: 开源image2调用图像生成/编辑桌面客户端 · SSE 流式保活,兼容 Cloudflare 524/504 超时截断 · Wails (Go + React/TS) ·   数据 100% 本地

summary.zh: Image Studio 是面向 OpenAI 兼容上游的开源图像生成与编辑客户端，采用 Wails 结合 Go、React/TS 构建桌面端，并提供 Android 壳层。其核心亮点是以 Responses API 的 SSE 流式保活缓解 Cloudflare 或 Nginx 下长时推理导致的 524/504 断连，同时兼容标准 Images API，且配置与数据均本地保存。
summary.en: Image Studio is an open-source image generation and editing client for OpenAI-compatible providers, built with Wails using Go and React/TypeScript for desktop, plus an Android WebView shell. Its key value is handling long-running image inference more reliably behind Cloudflare or Nginx by using SSE-based keep-alive with the Responses API to reduce 524/504 disconnects, while also supporting the standard Images API for generation and edits. Configuration and user data stay fully local, making it practical for privacy-conscious, cross-platform creative workflows.

summary.zh: smart-search 是面向 AI 智能体与终端用户的 CLI 研究工具，统一封装实时搜索、网页抓取、站点映射、来源发现与离线 Deep Research 规划。它以技能驱动接入 Codex、Claude 等工具，强调可复现命令层、Provider 路由与诊断能力，适合自动化调研、证据收集和结构化研究流程。
summary.en: smart-search is a CLI-first research tool for AI agents and terminal users, providing a reproducible command layer for live web search, source discovery, page fetching, site mapping, provider diagnostics, and offline Deep Research planning. Its architecture separates deterministic CLI execution from agent orchestration, making it well suited for automated investigation, evidence collection, and structured research workflows. It also integrates with tools like Codex and Claude through installable skills, while supporting provider routing, fallback handling, and JSON/Markdown outputs for reliable automation.

metadata.name: ppt-master
metadata.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He

summary.zh: PPT Master 是一款将文档自动生成可原生编辑 PPTX 的 AI 办公工具，支持文本、结构与视觉内容协同生成，输出真实形状、动画与语音旁白，而非静态截图。项目可套用自定义 .pptx 模板，适合课程课件、汇报演示、论文解读与内容营销场景，突出可编辑性、模板继承和自动化出片效率。
summary.en: PPT Master is an AI-powered presentation automation tool that turns documents into fully editable PPTX files rather than flat slide images. It generates native PowerPoint shapes, layouts, animations, and even speaker notes voiced as audio narration. The system can also follow a user’s own .pptx template, making it practical for business reporting, teaching materials, research explainers, and marketing decks. Its main strengths are true editability, template reuse, and efficient end-to-end slide production with AI assistance.

summary.zh: 该仓库聚焦 Codex Skills 的集中发布与维护，提供通过 `skills` CLI 统一安装、更新和同步的分发方式。当前内置 `gpt-imagegen`，面向兼容 OpenAI `gpt-image-2` 的图像生成与编辑场景，突出模块化目录组织、独立 skill 封装以及环境变量驱动的快速接入能力。
summary.en: This repository is a distribution hub for Codex Skills, designed to publish, maintain, install, update, and sync reusable skills through a unified `skills` CLI workflow. Its current featured skill, `gpt-imagegen`, targets image generation and image editing against OpenAI-compatible `gpt-image-2` APIs. The main strengths are a modular repository structure, per-skill packaging, clear operational conventions, and lightweight environment-variable configuration for fast integration into agent-driven automation and creative tooling scenarios.

metadata.name: hyperframes-fix
metadata.description: HyperFrames-fix 一键生成可上传有流量视频 。目的是让 HyperFrames 生成视频适应国内需求，1 流畅的中文语音， 2 中文短视频样式新增， 3 优化整个生成视频流程。 基本上现在一键就可以完成横版竖版的快节奏短视频，例如随便丢给一个文章，一个doc，就能够制作视频！ 太棒！

summary.zh: HyperFrames-fix 面向中文短视频生产场景，扩展 HyperFrames 的语音、排版与自动化流程能力。项目接入 Minimax 中文语音，并支持从文章、文档到素材抓取、文案生成、信息流样式编排和横竖版视频输出的一键制作，适合内容营销、自媒体批量生产与高频分发。
summary.en: HyperFrames-fix adapts HyperFrames for Chinese short-form video production by improving voice quality, layout styles, and end-to-end automation. It integrates Minimax for natural Chinese speech and streamlines the workflow from article or document input to asset collection, script generation, infographic-style composition, and final horizontal or vertical video export. The project is aimed at creators, marketers, and media teams that need to produce upload-ready, high-volume social videos quickly with minimal manual editing.

metadata.name: ProductFlow
metadata.description: gpt-image-2 画图工作台 / Self-hosted workbench for AI copy, posters, image sessions, and visual product workflows

summary.zh: ProductFlow 是面向单人或小团队商家的自托管商品素材工作台，整合商品资料、参考图、AI 文案、海报生成、连续生图会话与画廊管理。基于 FastAPI、React、PostgreSQL、Redis 与 Dramatiq 构建，支持可视化节点工作流、移动端画布交互、运行时模型配置和异步任务恢复，适合电商视觉物料生产与迭代。
summary.en: ProductFlow is a self-hosted creative workbench for solo sellers and small commerce teams, combining product assets, reference images, AI copywriting, poster generation, iterative image sessions, and gallery management in one workflow. Built with FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Dramatiq, it emphasizes visual node-based orchestration, mobile-friendly canvas interactions, runtime model configuration, and resumable async jobs. It fits e-commerce teams that need structured, repeatable production of marketing visuals and product-facing creative assets.

metadata.name: ecom-details-image
metadata.description: 一个面向 claude code / Codex / OpenClaw 的跨境电商和国内电商通用视觉创作 Skill。我精选25个高质量案例，涵盖纯色底产品主图、场景化生活图、平铺图、电商详情图、真实场景等等，全部配完整提示词，都可以利用 GPT-Image-2 API生成最终效果。一键生成电商相关图片！输入产品图片和需求描述，自动生成完整的电商主图、详情页图片、社媒推广图、直播间场景图等全套视觉素材。 与众不同之处是：**Campaign Style Lock** 机制 和 **强推广** 和 **重视转化效果**。

summary.zh: 该仓库是面向 Claude Code、Codex 与 OpenClaw 的电商视觉生成 Skill，围绕 GPT-Image-2 API 提供主图、详情页、社媒与直播场景的一站式出图能力。其核心亮点是 Campaign Style Lock 保证多图风格统一，并结合转化驱动力诊断生成更适合营销投放的视觉方案，兼顾 Prompt 产出与 API 直连生成。
summary.en: This repository is an e-commerce visual generation skill for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, built around GPT-Image-2 style image APIs. It generates product hero images, detail-page creatives, social media assets, and livestream visuals from product photos and requirements. Its main strengths are Campaign Style Lock for consistent multi-image branding and conversion-oriented visual planning, while supporting both prompt-only workflows and direct API-based image generation.

metadata.name: gpt-image2-ecommerce
metadata.description: GPT-Image-2 驱动的电商素材一键生成 Claude Code Skill | E-commerce image generation skill powered by GPT-Image-2 via Codex CLI, with 25 built-in scene templates

summary.zh: 该项目是基于 Codex CLI 与 GPT-Image-2 的电商素材生成 Skill，面向商品主图、海报、UGC、直播等场景，内置 25 个结构化模板并支持自然语言自动匹配。其亮点在于参考图一致性控制、反 AI 感处理与跨 Agent 调用能力，适合提升电商视觉生产效率。
summary.en: This repository provides an e-commerce image generation skill built on Codex CLI and GPT-Image-2. It targets common commerce creative needs such as hero images, posters, UGC, livestream visuals, and social media assets, using 25 structured prompt templates with automatic natural-language template matching. Key strengths include reference-image consistency, anti-AI-look treatment for more realistic outputs, and broad compatibility across shell-capable AI agents, making it practical for scalable visual content production.

metadata.name: anything-analyzer
metadata.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration

summary.zh: Anything Analyzer 是面向协议逆向与安全分析的一体化桌面工具，集成浏览器抓包、MITM 代理、JS Hook 与指纹伪装，将网页、桌面端、脚本、终端和移动端流量汇入统一会话，再用 AI 自动完成接口识别、加密分析、安全审计与报告生成，并可通过 MCP Server 接入 AI Agent 与 IDE。
summary.en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one desktop toolkit for protocol reverse engineering and traffic analysis. It combines built-in browser capture, MITM proxying, JavaScript hooks, and fingerprint spoofing to collect traffic from web apps, desktop clients, scripts, terminals, and mobile devices into a unified session. Its AI workflow then filters noise, identifies APIs, inspects encryption logic, and generates reverse-engineering or security audit reports. With built-in MCP server support, it also exposes these capabilities to AI agents and IDEs for automated analysis.

metadata.name: js-reverse-mcp
metadata.description: AI Agent-first JS 逆向 MCP Server：有头 Chrome 调试、断点、网络/WebSocket 分析、Patchright 反检测，可选 CloakBrowser。

summary.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 JavaScript 逆向 MCP 服务器，重构自 chrome-devtools-mcp，结合 Patchright 与可选 CloakBrowser 实现双层反检测。它以真实 Chrome 有头调试、持久化登录态和零注入设计，支持脚本检索、断点调试、运行时求值与网络分析，适用于强反爬站点的自动化 JS 分析与逆向研究。
summary.en: JS Reverse MCP is an agent-first JavaScript reverse engineering server for AI coding assistants, rebuilt from chrome-devtools-mcp. It combines Patchright protocol-level stealth with optional CloakBrowser binary fingerprint patches to handle heavily defended sites. With headed real-Chrome debugging, persistent login state, and zero JS injection, it supports script discovery, source retrieval, breakpoint debugging, runtime inspection, and network tracing. It is designed for automated JS analysis and reverse engineering workflows where anti-bot evasion and accurate browser behavior both matter.

metadata.name: wx4py
metadata.description: 微信4.x自动化机器人：群聊机器人、批量群发（支持文件）、批量设置群公告、聊天记录导出、群管理 | 5分钟上手

summary.zh: wx4py 是面向微信4.x的 Python 自动化框架，聚焦群聊机器人、批量群发、群公告管理、聊天记录导出与转发等高频场景。其以 Windows 桌面自动化封装统一接口，支持文件发送、定时任务与 AI 接入，适合企业运营、社群管理和办公流程提效。
summary.en: wx4py is a Python automation framework for WeChat 4.x on Windows, designed for high-frequency operational workflows such as group bots, bulk messaging, file distribution, announcement management, chat history export, and message forwarding. It wraps desktop automation into a simpler developer-facing API, making WeChat automation usable in minutes. The project also supports scheduled tasks and AI-driven auto-replies in group chats, which makes it practical for enterprise operations, community management, data extraction, and general productivity automation.

metadata.name: ssh-mcp-server
metadata.description: 基于 SSH 的 MCP 服务 🧙‍♀️。已被MCP官方收录 🎉。 SSH MCP Server 🧙‍♀️. It has been included in the community MCP repository 🎉.

summary.zh: ssh-mcp-server 是连接 AI 助手与远程主机的 SSH 型 MCP 服务，面向运维自动化、远程执行与文件传输场景。项目以 MCP 标准接口封装 SSH，支持密码/密钥认证、堡垒机场景、命令黑白名单和凭据本地隔离，在提升可集成性的同时强化安全控制。
summary.en: ssh-mcp-server is an SSH-based MCP server that lets AI assistants and MCP-compatible tools execute commands and transfer files on remote machines through a standardized interface. It targets operations automation, secure remote administration, and AI-driven infrastructure workflows. Key strengths include password and private-key authentication, bastion and jump-host support, command whitelist and blacklist controls, dual transport modes, and strict local credential isolation so SSH secrets are never exposed directly to the model.

metadata.name: c_cleaner_plus
metadata.description: Windows的开源强力清理工具，可扫描并清理全盘中的垃圾文件、大文件、重复文件及系统残留等

summary.zh: C Cleaner Plus 是面向 Windows 的开源全盘清理工具，集垃圾清理、大文件扫描、重复文件查找、残留卸载与定时任务于一体。项目基于 Python、PySide6 与 Fluent UI，提供图形化操作、管理员提权、远程规则包导入及分级风险拦截，适合个人设备维护与重度软件环境清理。
summary.en: C Cleaner Plus is an open-source Windows cleanup tool for full-disk maintenance, combining junk file cleanup, large-file scanning, duplicate detection, residual app removal, and scheduled tasks in one GUI application. Built with Python, PySide6, and Fluent UI, it supports admin elevation, customizable rules, remote rule package import, and risk-tiered protection for aggressive uninstall workflows. It is well suited for personal PC maintenance, developer workstations, and software-heavy environments that accumulate caches, leftovers, and storage waste over time.

metadata.name: gpt_image_playground
metadata.description: 基于 OpenAI gpt-image-2 API 的图片生成与编辑工具

summary.zh: 这是一个面向创作与迭代修图场景的 Web 图像工作台，基于 OpenAI gpt-image-2 与兼容接口，集成参考图、遮罩编辑、流式预览、Agent 多轮生成及本地历史管理，兼顾隐私、批量效率与多服务商接入能力，并支持参数追踪、配置切换和导出备份。
summary.en: GPT Image Playground is a browser-based image generation and editing workspace built around OpenAI gpt-image-2 and compatible APIs. It is designed for creative iteration, supporting text-to-image, reference-image and mask-based editing, streaming previews, and agent-style multi-turn generation. The app keeps history and assets locally in IndexedDB for stronger privacy, while adding detailed parameter tracking, batch workflows, provider switching, custom HTTP integrations, and exportable backups. Its main value is combining polished UX with flexible model access for fast visual experimentation.

metadata.name: last30days-skill
metadata.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AI 智能体的跨平台检索技能，可并行抓取 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 与网页近 30 天内容，并按点赞、热度与市场信号加权。它适合行业研究、人物背调、商业情报和热点追踪，亮点在于多源桥接、零配置接入与基于真实用户反馈的综合摘要。
summary.en: Last30days is an AI agent skill for cross-platform research that searches Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, GitHub, and the open web across the most recent 30 days, then produces a grounded synthesis. Instead of relying on editorial ranking, it weights signals such as upvotes, likes, transcripts, and market odds to surface what people actually care about. It is well suited for market research, executive briefing, trend tracking, and fast due diligence, with key strengths in multi-source aggregation, parallel search, and agent-driven summarization.

metadata.name: happy
metadata.description: Mobile and Web client for Codex and Claude Code, with realtime voice, encryption and fully featured

summary.zh: Happy 是面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的移动端和 Web 客户端，通过 CLI 包装与远程会话切换，让开发者在手机、网页和桌面间无缝接管 AI 编程任务。其亮点是端到端加密、实时语音、推送通知与开源可审计，适合远程查看、审批和继续执行编码流程。
summary.en: Happy is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex that extends local coding-agent workflows to phones and browsers through a CLI wrapper and remote session handoff. It lets developers monitor, control, and resume AI coding tasks across devices without being tied to a desktop. Key strengths include end-to-end encryption, realtime voice interaction, push notifications for approvals or failures, and an open-source architecture spanning app, CLI, agent, and server components for secure remote development access.

metadata.name: hermes-web-ui
metadata.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics

summary.zh: Hermes Web UI 是面向 Hermes Agent 的桌面与网页一体化控制台，聚焦多平台 AI 对话运营。它整合会话管理、渠道配置、定时任务、技能浏览与用量成本分析，支持 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等多渠道统一接入。技术亮点包括基于 Socket.IO 的实时流式聊天、本地 SQLite 会话库、跨本地与容器环境的文件处理，以及响应式 Web 界面与桌面分发能力。
summary.en: Hermes Web UI is a unified desktop app and web dashboard built for Hermes Agent, designed to manage multi-platform AI chat operations from a single interface. It combines real-time streaming conversations, session management, platform channel configuration, scheduled jobs, skill browsing, and usage or cost analytics. Key technical strengths include Socket.IO-based live chat, a local SQLite session store, profile-aware model discovery, and file handling across local, Docker, SSH, and Singularity backends, all delivered through a responsive web interface with desktop distribution support.

metadata.name: dots2api
metadata.description: dots.ai OpenAI compatible API

summary.zh: dots2api 将 dots.ai 封装为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持文本与图片能力，便于 Cherry Studio、OpenAI SDK 等现有客户端直接接入。项目基于 Python 与 Playwright，通过浏览器登录态复用实现本地、Docker 与云端部署，适合低成本接入第三方模型服务与统一 API 网关场景。
summary.en: dots2api wraps dots.ai as an OpenAI-compatible API, exposing both text and image capabilities through a familiar `/v1` interface. It is designed for direct use with existing clients such as Cherry Studio and the OpenAI SDK, reducing integration cost and migration effort. Built with Python and Playwright, it reuses browser login sessions to bridge a third-party AI service into local, Docker, or cloud deployments. The project is well suited for lightweight model access, API standardization, and rapid compatibility layering.

metadata.name: oh-story-claudecode
metadata.description: 网文/小说写作 skill 包，覆盖长篇与短篇网络小说的扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图全流程

summary.zh: 这是面向网文作者的 Claude Code/OpenClaw 写作 skill 包，把扫榜、拆文、长短篇创作、审稿、去AI味与封面生成串成完整流程。其亮点是以榜单分析和剧情模块化为方法核心，结合多 Agent、状态分层管理与浏览器抓取，提升选题判断、结构复用和商业化写作效率。
summary.en: This repository is a fiction-writing skill package for Claude Code and OpenClaw, designed for web novel authors working on both long-form and short-form stories. It connects trend scanning, story teardown, drafting, review, AI-style cleanup, and cover generation into one workflow. Its main strength is a practical methodology built on bestseller analysis, modular plot reuse, layered context management, and human-AI collaboration, with browser-based data capture and multi-agent review to improve topic selection, narrative structure, and commercial writing output.

metadata.name: antigravity-proxy
metadata.description: 🚀 Transparent proxy injector for Antigravity. Force SOCKS5/HTTP proxy without TUN mode on Windows. | 专为 Antigravity 打造的免 TUN 强制代理工具，支持 DLL 注入与进程流量劫持。

summary.zh: Antigravity-Proxy 是面向 Windows 的透明代理注入工具，专为 Antigravity 编辑器设计。它通过 DLL 注入、API Hook 与进程流量劫持，将指定进程稳定强制走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，无需开启 TUN 或接管全局流量，适合受限网络环境下的编辑器联网、Agent 调用与故障排查场景。
summary.en: Antigravity-Proxy is a Windows transparent proxy injector built for the Antigravity editor. It uses DLL injection, API hooking, and per-process traffic interception to force selected processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies without enabling TUN mode or redirecting system-wide traffic. The project targets restricted-network environments, especially where users need stable editor connectivity, agent execution, and proxy diagnostics while avoiding global proxy side effects and elevated networking setup.

metadata.name: shop-tryon-skill
metadata.description: 一个用于 AI 虚拟试衣的 Agent Skill。用户可以通过“上传服装图/模特图”或“文字描述”快速生成试穿效果图，并可继续生成多角度素材和展示视频。

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 AI 虚拟试衣的 Agent Skill，支持服装图、模特图与文字描述混合输入，完成服装分析、模特推荐、试穿合成、多角度扩展到展示视频生成的完整链路。项目集成阿里云百炼、豆包与即梦等多后端，适用于电商上新预览、穿搭展示和短视频素材生产，强调可对话流程与会话化输出管理。
summary.en: This repository delivers an AI virtual try-on agent skill that accepts garment images, model images, and text prompts to produce a full workflow from garment analysis and model selection to try-on synthesis, multi-angle asset generation, and showcase video creation. It integrates multiple generation backends including Alibaba Bailian, Doubao Seedream/Seedance, and Jimeng, making it practical for e-commerce previewing, outfit presentation, and short-form visual content production. Its key strength is a dialogue-driven orchestration flow with structured session-based output management.

metadata.name: open-codesign
metadata.description: Open-source Claude Design alternative. One-click import your Claude Code / Codex API key. Prompt → prototype / slides / PDF. Multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama). BYOK, local-first, MIT.

summary.zh: Open CoDesign 是面向本地创作的开源 AI 设计工具，支持一键导入 Claude Code 或 Codex 密钥，基于提示词生成原型、演示文稿与 PDF。其亮点在于多模型接入、BYOK、本地优先与 MIT 开源，适合产品设计、快速提案和个人私有化创作流程。
summary.en: Open CoDesign is an open-source, local-first AI design tool that turns prompts into polished prototypes, slide decks, and PDFs. It supports one-click import of Claude Code or Codex API credentials and works with multiple model providers including Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, and Ollama. Its core value is combining BYOK flexibility, desktop-local workflows, and open MIT licensing, making it well suited for rapid prototyping, design exploration, presentations, and privacy-conscious personal or team creative workflows.

metadata.name: open-codex-computer-use
metadata.description: 👾 Open Computer Use – Open-Source Alternative to Codex Computer Use

summary.zh: open-computer-use 是面向 AI 智能体的开源 Computer Use 服务，通过 MCP 将桌面操作能力标准化输出，支持 macOS、Linux 与 Windows。项目基于无侵入式辅助功能与屏幕控制方案，兼容 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等客户端，适合自动化办公、跨平台桌面代理与 AI 工作流集成。
summary.en: open-computer-use is an open-source Computer Use service for AI agents, exposed through MCP so clients can drive desktop actions in a standardized way across macOS, Linux, and Windows. Inspired by Codex Computer Use, it uses a non-intrusive accessibility-based approach rather than heavyweight virtualization. The project integrates with Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other MCP clients, making it well suited for desktop automation, cross-platform agent execution, and AI workflow orchestration.

summary.zh: CodeStable 是一套面向长期软件迭代的 AI 编码工作流，以“人在环”为核心，将需求、架构、路线图、特性、问题和知识沉淀进可读文件树，帮助团队在复杂工程中稳定管理上下文、约束与决策，并通过技能链支持特性开发、缺陷修复和重构。
summary.en: CodeStable is a lightweight AI coding workflow for serious, long-lived software projects. Instead of orchestrating agents, it organizes the software lifecycle itself around requirements, architecture, roadmaps, features, issues, and accumulated knowledge. Its human-in-the-loop design stores project state in a readable file tree, making constraints and decisions recoverable over time. The framework provides skill-based workflows for feature delivery, bug fixing, and refactoring, aiming to keep AI-assisted engineering stable, auditable, and maintainable as project complexity grows.

metadata.name: she-love-me
metadata.description: 她不一样   恋情分析室 — 微信聊天记录恋爱分析 Agent Skill  （曾用名：她爱我吗？）

summary.zh: 她不一样是面向微信、QQ聊天记录的本地恋情分析 Agent Skill，可自动解密与导出数据，结合依恋类型、Gottman 与 Sternberg 等心理学框架，生成量化指标、风险预警、趋势图表和关系建议，适用于情感关系复盘、恋爱状态判断与聊天互动洞察。
summary.en: She Love Me is a local-first Agent Skill for analyzing romantic dynamics from WeChat and QQ chat histories. It automates decryption, export, contact selection, and layered analysis, then combines quantitative metrics with psychology frameworks such as attachment styles, Gottman patterns, and Sternberg's triangle. The project produces relationship scores, risk signals, trend charts, and actionable advice in Markdown and HTML reports, making it useful for emotional retrospectives, relationship assessment, and conversation behavior insight without uploading private data to external servers.

metadata.name: UZI-Skill
metadata.description: 冰冷的钱就这样流进我温暖的口袋-游资（UZI）Skills — 让我们欢迎，股海贼王！66位投资大佬帮你看盘 · 22维数据 × 180条量化规则 × 17种机构分析方法 · A股/港股/美股

summary.zh: UZI-Skill 是面向 A股、港股、美股的 AI 股票分析技能库，可在多种 Agent/CLI 中直接调用。它整合 22 维数据、180 条量化规则、17 种机构分析方法与多位投资风格评审，支持深度分析、快扫、陷阱识别和 DCF 估值，强调可落地的研判流程与跨平台集成能力。
summary.en: UZI-Skill is an AI-powered stock analysis skill for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, and US equities that plugs directly into multiple agents and CLI environments. It combines 22 data dimensions, 180 quantitative rules, 17 institutional analysis methods, and a panel of investor-style evaluators to deliver deep research, quick scans, trap detection, and DCF valuation. Its main strengths are structured decision support, cross-platform integration, and a modular pipeline designed for practical market analysis rather than generic financial commentary.

metadata.name: hermes-agent
metadata.description: The agent that grows with you

summary.zh: Hermes Agent 是面向个人与团队的自进化 AI 智能体框架，支持多模型切换、跨平台消息接入与云端运行。其核心亮点是内置学习闭环，可从任务经验生成并优化技能，结合记忆检索、用户建模、定时自动化与并行子代理，适用于长期助手、自动运维、研究实验等场景。
summary.en: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent framework for individuals and teams, designed to run across CLI, chat platforms, and cloud environments. Its core differentiator is a built-in learning loop that creates and refines skills from experience, persists memory across sessions, and models user preferences over time. With model-agnostic deployment, scheduled automations, subagent parallelization, and multiple execution backends, it fits long-running assistants, operations workflows, and research-grade agent experimentation.

metadata.name: graphify
metadata.description: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.

summary.zh: Graphify 将代码、SQL、脚本、文档乃至图片视频统一映射为可查询知识图谱，面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手。其亮点是跨语言多模态索引、项目结构与数据库/基础设施关联建模，帮助开发者替代 grep，提升代码理解、检索与上下文注入效率。
summary.en: Graphify turns an entire project folder, including source code, SQL schemas, shell scripts, papers, docs, images, and videos, into a queryable knowledge graph for AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. Its core value is giving agents structured project memory instead of flat file search. Key strengths include multimodal ingestion, cross-file relationship mapping, and unified modeling of application code, database schema, and infrastructure, which improves code discovery, architectural understanding, and context retrieval for developer workflows.

metadata.name: douyin-upload-mcp-skill
metadata.description: 基于浏览器自动化的抖音视频/图文上传 MCP & Skill，适用于openclaw或任何支持skill，mcp的agent.  o(￣▽￣)ブ

summary.zh: 该仓库提供基于 CDP 的抖音创作者平台自动化发布能力，并通过 MCP/Skill 接口对外暴露，适合集成到 OpenClaw 等智能体工作流。其核心价值在于打通视频与图文一键上传、登录推进、浏览器托管和会话复用，结合独立 Daemon 管理 Chrome 生命周期，兼顾自动化稳定性、可集成性与多 Agent 协同使用场景。
summary.en: This repository delivers CDP-based automation for publishing videos and image-text posts to the Douyin Creator Platform, exposed through MCP and Skill interfaces for agents such as OpenClaw. Its main value is end-to-end automation across upload, login progression, browser lifecycle management, and session reuse. With a daemon-managed Chrome process and modular MCP tooling, it is well suited for agent workflows that need reliable social media publishing automation.

metadata.name: TripStar
metadata.description: 旅途星辰 (TripStar)是一个创新的 AI 文旅智能体应用，旨在解决用户在规划旅行时面临的各种问题，为提供一站式旅游攻略而生。

summary.zh: TripStar 是面向自由行与多城市出游的 AI 文旅智能体平台，基于 HelloAgents、LLM 与多智能体协作，自动完成景点筛选、路线编排、预算拆解与天气联动。项目结合小红书真实游记、双地图引擎、知识图谱可视化和多语言交互，适合打造一站式个性化旅游攻略系统。
summary.en: TripStar is an AI travel-planning agent platform for independent and multi-city trips. Built on HelloAgents with LLM and multi-agent orchestration, it automates attraction discovery, itinerary generation, budget breakdown, and weather-aware scheduling. The system stands out by integrating real Xiaohongshu travel notes, dual map engines with fallback, knowledge graph visualization, and multilingual interaction. It is well suited for building a one-stop, personalized tourism assistant that reduces information overload and decision fatigue during trip planning.

metadata.name: MoneyPrinterV2
metadata.description: Automate the process of making money online.

summary.zh: MoneyPrinter V2 是一个基于 Python 3.12 的在线收益自动化框架，围绕 Twitter 机器人、YouTube Shorts 批量生成、联盟营销与本地商家线索挖掘，提供定时调度、脚本化执行和模块化扩展能力，适合内容营销与冷启动获客场景。
summary.en: MoneyPrinter V2 is a Python 3.12 automation framework for online growth and monetization workflows. It combines Twitter bot operations, YouTube Shorts automation, affiliate marketing flows, and local business lead discovery with cold outreach support. The project is a full rewrite with a more modular architecture, scriptable entry points, and scheduler-based recurring jobs, making it suitable for creators, growth hackers, and operators who want to automate content distribution and prospecting pipelines rather than build isolated one-off scripts.

metadata.name: comfyui-workflow-skill
metadata.description: Natural language → ComfyUI workflow JSON. 34 built-in templates, 360+ node definitions, auto model download. Supports txt2img,       img2img, txt2vid, img2vid, audio, 3D generation across SD1.5/SDXL/SD3/FLUX/Wan2.2/HunyuanVideo/LTXV/Mochi/Cosmos + LLM integration.    Works as a skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding agents.

summary.zh: 该项目将自然语言直接转换为可导入 ComfyUI 的工作流 JSON，面向图像、视频、音频与 3D 生成场景。内置 34 类模板、360+ 节点定义与自动模型下载机制，并可作为 Claude Code、Cursor 等智能体技能，显著降低复杂节点编排与多模型工作流搭建门槛。
summary.en: ComfyUI Workflow Skill turns natural-language requests into valid ComfyUI workflow JSON that can be imported and executed directly, without backend services or API fees. It targets image, video, audio, and 3D generation with 34 built-in templates, 360+ typed node definitions, automatic model download support, and optional LLM node integration. Designed for Claude Code, Cursor, and other coding agents, it reduces the overhead of wiring complex multimodal workflows across major diffusion and video models.

metadata.name: paperclip
metadata.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work

summary.zh: Paperclip 是面向团队的开源 AI 智能体编排平台，以 Node.js 服务端和 React 控制台统一管理多智能体协作。它支持接入不同代理与运行时，围绕业务目标进行任务分工、预算控制、治理审计和成本追踪，适合构建可持续运行的自动化 AI 业务组织。
summary.en: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration platform for teams that run multiple AI agents toward shared business goals. Built with a Node.js backend and a React dashboard, it lets users bring their own agents and coordinate them through org structures, goal assignment, approvals, budget controls, governance, and cost tracking. Its core value is turning scattered autonomous agents into a manageable operating system for AI-driven work, making it well suited for continuous, auditable, multi-agent business automation.

metadata.name: gemini-skill
metadata.description: gemini drawing MCP & skill through browser, can be used in openclaw or any agent that supports MCP. Gemini画图 MCP和sill，支持龙虾或任何agent使用٩(๑>◡<๑)۶

summary.zh: 该项目通过 CDP 自动操控 Gemini 网页版，向支持 MCP 的智能体提供生图、对话、图片上传提取与会话管理能力，并兼容新版 UI。其亮点是浏览器自动化链路稳定、支持高清下载与自动去水印，同时内置 Atlas Cloud Provider，便于统一接入多模态模型与代理工具生态。
summary.en: Gemini Skill uses CDP to automate the Gemini web app and expose image generation, chat, image upload and extraction, and session control as MCP-compatible tools for agents such as OpenClaw. Its core value is turning Gemini's browser interface into a stable, reusable automation skill rather than a one-off script. Key strengths include adaptation to new Gemini UI changes, full-resolution image download, watermark removal, and an embedded Atlas Cloud provider that extends the project toward unified multimodal model access and agent integration.

metadata.name: xiaohu-wechat-format
metadata.description: Claude Code 公众号一键排版+发布技能 | Markdown → 微信兼容 HTML → 推送草稿箱 | 30 套主题 + 可视化画廊

summary.zh: 该仓库面向微信公众号内容生产，提供从 Markdown 排版、主题预览到草稿发布的一体化流程。它将文章转换为微信兼容的内联 HTML，内置 30 套主题与可视化画廊，并结合 AI 自动增强对话、金句和图组等内容结构，适合内容运营、自媒体与知识输出场景。
summary.en: This repository targets the full publishing workflow for WeChat Official Accounts, covering Markdown formatting, theme preview, optional cover generation, and draft publishing. It converts standard Markdown into WeChat-compatible inline HTML, ships with 30 themes and a visual gallery, and uses AI-assisted content enhancement to recognize dialogues, quotes, and image groups. It is especially useful for content teams, independent creators, and knowledge publishing workflows that need faster, repeatable, and visually consistent article production.

metadata.name: codex-session-patcher
metadata.description: A lightweight Python tool to clean AI refusal responses from Codex CLI session files

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AI 编码工具的会话修复与安全测试增强工具，支持 Codex CLI、Claude Code、OpenCode。它可批量识别并改写拒绝回复、清除推理内容、备份恢复，并通过配置注入 CTF/渗透测试上下文，配合 Web UI 实现多平台会话管理、差异预览与实时日志。
summary.en: Codex Session Patcher is a lightweight Python utility for repairing AI coding tool sessions and improving security-testing workflows across Codex CLI, Claude Code, and OpenCode. It detects and rewrites refusal responses, removes reasoning blocks, supports backup and restore, and injects CTF or penetration-testing context at the configuration layer to reduce future refusals. A Web UI adds cross-platform session management, diff preview, filtering, and real-time logs.

metadata.name: shanyin-screenwriting-master
metadata.description: 山音超级编剧大师——由 @山音 设计的全格式影视编剧技能。 覆盖从1-3分钟概念超短片到90分钟电影长片、多集剧集的全格式剧本创作。 支持四种格式：概念超短片（how-to-tell/what-if）、5-10分钟叙事短片、90分钟长片（商业/文艺）、多集剧集。 覆盖从人物设计、结构大纲、场景拆解、到完整剧本写作的全流程。

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 Claude/GPT 的自然语言编剧 Skill，覆盖概念超短片、叙事短片、90分钟长片与多集剧集创作，支持人物设定、结构大纲、场景拆解到标准剧本输出，突出全格式适配、类型化叙事框架与一站式全流程编排能力。
summary.en: This repository packages a natural-language screenwriting skill for Claude, GPT, and similar LLM tools. It supports end-to-end creation across ultra-short concept films, narrative shorts, feature-length movies, and episodic series. The skill guides users through character design, story structure, scene breakdowns, and properly formatted screenplay output. Its main strengths are format-aware workflows, genre-specific narrative frameworks, and low-friction prompting that turns broad creative ideas into production-ready outlines and scripts for filmmakers, AIGC creators, and writers working across short-video, film, and series scenarios.

metadata.name: inkos
metadata.description: Story Creation AI Agent for novel, scripts, translation, interactive games, and IP content

summary.zh: InkOS 是面向网文与长短篇创作的自治式小说写作 AI Agent，通过写作、审稿、修订多代理协作与人工审核门控，完成从大纲到正文的生产闭环。项目提供 CLI、TUI、Studio 与 OpenClaw Skill 统一交互层，支持多模型接入、封面生成、数据分析和文风检测，适合小说连载、续写、同人及内容工作流自动化。
summary.en: InkOS is an autonomous AI agent for novel creation, built to handle outlining, drafting, auditing, and revision through coordinated multi-agent workflows with human review gates. It targets web fiction, short stories, fan fiction, continuations, and style-based imitation. The project exposes a unified interaction core across CLI, TUI, Studio, and OpenClaw Skill, while supporting multi-model integration, cover prompt and image generation, progress tracking, analytics, and style inspection for end-to-end writing workflow automation.

metadata.name: cose
metadata.description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。

summary.zh: COSE 是面向 Markdown 创作者的浏览器扩展，与 doocs/md 配合实现“一次编辑，多平台同步发布”。它本地运行，不采集用户数据，支持登录态检测、标签页分组及微信公众号样式保真草稿保存，适合自媒体、技术博客与内容运营场景，显著降低多平台分发成本。
summary.en: COSE is a browser extension built for Markdown-based publishing workflows, designed to work with doocs/md and enable write-once, publish-everywhere distribution. It helps creators sync articles to many content platforms with one click while running fully locally, without collecting or storing user data. Key strengths include automatic login-state detection, grouped sync tabs for easier management, and high-fidelity WeChat Official Account publishing that preserves rendered styles and saves drafts automatically. It is especially useful for bloggers, technical writers, and content operators managing multi-platform distribution.

metadata.name: openclaw-search-skills
metadata.description: OpenClaw skills for deep search — multi-source search, content extraction, and structured research reports.

summary.zh: 该仓库为 OpenClaw Agent 提供生产级深度搜索 Skills，整合 Brave、Exa、Tavily、Grok 多源并行检索，支持意图感知排序、链式引用追踪与线程深挖，并结合 MinerU 实现反爬页面和文档到 Markdown 的高保真提取，适用于技术调研、事实核查、社区问题追踪与结构化研究报告生成。
summary.en: This repository delivers production-grade search skills for OpenClaw agents, combining Brave, Exa, Tavily, and Grok for parallel multi-source retrieval. It adds intent-aware ranking, citation-chain exploration, and thread-level investigation across GitHub issues, forums, and web articles. Paired with MinerU-backed extraction, it converts anti-bot pages, PDFs, Office files, and HTML into clean Markdown. It is well suited for deep research, technical discovery, fact finding, discussion tracing, and generating structured research reports from heterogeneous sources.

summary.zh: MiniMax Skills 是面向 AI 编码代理的技能仓库，提供前端、全栈、移动端、Shader 与办公文档生成等结构化开发指引。其亮点是将 React/Next.js、Kotlin、Swift、Flutter 等主流栈与 MiniMax 多模态 API、动画设计、工程规范和生产级交付流程结合，帮助开发者快速接入并稳定落地复杂应用。
summary.en: MiniMax Skills is a skill library for AI coding agents, offering structured, production-oriented guidance across frontend, full-stack, mobile, shader programming, and document automation workflows. Its core value lies in combining mainstream stacks such as React/Next.js, Kotlin, Swift, and Flutter with MiniMax multimodal APIs, animation tooling, UI design practices, and delivery checklists. This makes it useful for teams building complex apps, media-rich experiences, and automated office document pipelines with consistent engineering quality.

metadata.name: gstack
metadata.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

summary.zh: gstack 将 Claude Code 封装为可复用的“虚拟产品研发团队”，提供 23 个角色化命令与 8 个增强工具，覆盖产品评审、架构设计、代码审查、QA、安全审计和发布流程。它面向创始人、技术负责人和独立开发者，帮助个人以低成本建立标准化的软件交付流水线，提升 AI 辅助开发的质量、速度与一致性。
summary.en: gstack packages Claude Code into a reusable virtual product engineering team. It provides 23 opinionated role-based commands and 8 power tools spanning product review, architecture decisions, code review, QA, security auditing, and release management. Designed for founders, tech leads, and solo builders, it turns ad hoc prompting into a structured software delivery workflow. The core value is not just faster AI coding, but higher-quality execution through specialized agent roles, repeatable Markdown-based operations, and an open-source setup that makes individual developers operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

metadata.name: autoclip
metadata.description: AutoClip : AI-powered video clipping and highlight generation · 一款智能高光提取与剪辑的二创工具

summary.zh: AutoClip 是面向视频二创的 AI 自动化剪辑平台，支持 YouTube、B站与本地视频接入，结合大语言模型做内容理解、精彩片段提取和合集生成。系统采用 FastAPI + React 前后端分离架构，配合 Celery、Redis、WebSocket 实现异步处理、实时进度反馈与便捷部署。
summary.en: AutoClip is an AI-powered video repurposing platform for automatically downloading, analyzing, clipping, and compiling highlight segments from YouTube, Bilibili, and local video files. It uses large language models for content understanding and highlight extraction, then combines that with a modern FastAPI and React architecture for interactive web-based workflows. Celery, Redis, and WebSocket support asynchronous processing, task orchestration, and real-time progress updates, making the system practical for creators who need scalable, efficient secondary editing and highlight production.

summary.zh: aicoding-cookbook 聚焦 AI 编码工作流沉淀，提供 Augment MCP 配置指南、Codex Skills 复用包与 Python 辅助脚本，面向 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等工具，帮助团队快速搭建环境、标准化任务跟踪与技能打包流程。
summary.en: aicoding-cookbook is a practical repository for AI coding workflows, combining Augment MCP setup assets, reusable Codex skill packages, and Python helper scripts. Instead of being a framework or SDK, it focuses on operational reuse: configuring Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Augment environments, standardizing task tracking, and packaging or validating custom skills. Its main value is reducing repeated setup work and turning real-world AI-assisted development routines into repeatable, portable workflow assets.

summary.zh: vibe-101-publish 是面向内容分发场景的 Markdown 排版与发布工作台，覆盖公众号、知乎、Word 与社交卡片。它强调真实发布链路兼容性，提供多端预览、主题切换、平台定向复制、PDF/HTML/Word 导出及卡片拆分打包，适合高频多平台内容生产团队。
summary.en: vibe-101-publish is a Markdown formatting and publishing workstation built for real-world content distribution across WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Word, and social card workflows. Rather than focusing only on editor-side appearance, it optimizes the full publishing pipeline with multi-device preview, theme customization, platform-specific clipboard output, PDF/HTML/Word export, and card-based image generation with batch packaging. Its standout value is compatibility-oriented delivery, especially the dedicated Zhihu HTML pipeline and the card studio for turning long-form articles into publishable visual assets.

metadata.name: aigcpanel
metadata.description: AIGCPanel 是一个简单易用的一站式AI数字人系统，支持视频合成、声音合成、声音克隆，简化本地模型管理、一键导入和使用AI模型。

summary.zh: AIGCPanel 是面向内容生产与直播场景的一站式 AI 数字人桌面平台，集成视频换口型、语音合成、语音克隆、语音识别、音视频工具箱与模型管理，支持本地模型一键部署、远程 API 接入及可视化工作流，显著降低数字人制作与自动化运营门槛。
summary.en: AIGCPanel is an all-in-one AI digital human desktop platform for content creation and live streaming. It combines lip-sync video generation, text-to-speech, voice cloning, speech recognition, and a broad audio-video toolbox in one application. The product also streamlines local model deployment with one-click packages, supports remote API-based models, and adds visual workflow orchestration for automation. Built with TypeScript, Vue 3, and Electron, it targets non-expert users who need production-ready AI media pipelines across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

summary.zh: 该仓库面向 Windows 用户提供 OpenClaw 一键安装包，集成中文汉化版与官方英文版，免装 Node.js、Git、NPM 即可部署。项目内置全量技能、阿里源优化与卸载程序，降低本地搭建门槛，适合国内用户快速体验和稳定使用 OpenClaw。
summary.en: This repository packages OpenClaw as a Windows one-click installer for users who want fast local setup without preparing Node.js, Git, or NPM. It provides both a Chinese-localized build and the official English build, bundles the full default skill set, switches to Alibaba mirrors for better reliability in mainland China, and includes a clean uninstaller. Its main value is reducing deployment friction for OpenClaw, making evaluation, onboarding, and day-to-day local use much simpler for non-technical and China-based users.

metadata.name: OpenMOSS
metadata.description: A self-organizing multi-agent collaboration platform for OpenClaw. Multiple AI agents work as an autonomous team — planning, executing, reviewing, and patrolling tasks with zero human intervention.

summary.zh: OpenMOSS 是面向 OpenClaw 的多智能体协作平台，通过规划、执行、审查、巡查四类角色构建可自组织、自修复的 AI 工作流。系统结合 cron 调度、闭环质控、可插拔 Skill 与 Web 管理后台，适合内容生产、自主编程和持续运营等无人值守场景。
summary.en: OpenMOSS is a multi-agent collaboration platform built for OpenClaw, designed to run autonomous AI teams with planner, executor, reviewer, and patrol roles. It combines cron-based activation, closed-loop quality control, self-recovery, plug-in skills, and a built-in web console to support unattended workflows. The platform fits use cases such as content operations, autonomous software delivery, research assistance, and other continuously running task pipelines where coordination, monitoring, and iterative improvement matter.

metadata.name: openclaw-websearch-plugin
metadata.description: 为 OpenClaw 提供联网搜索能力的插件。通过飞书 / Telegram等 向 Agent 发消息，即可触发搜索、抓取网页、映射站点结构。

summary.zh: 该项目将 OpenClaw 的联网能力重构为原生搜索插件，支持 Tavily、Grok、Exa 等多引擎搜索、网页抓取与站点结构映射。相比依赖浏览器或内置 web_search 的方案，它以 Tool 方式直连 Agent，具备更快响应、结构化返回、多 Key 轮转和零编译部署等优势，适合消息渠道驱动的智能体联网检索与研究场景。
summary.en: OpenClaw Web Search Plugin turns web access into native Agent tools for fast, structured retrieval across Tavily, Grok, and Exa. It supports web search, deep research, page fetching, and site structure mapping through messaging channels such as Feishu, Telegram, and WeCom. Compared with browser-based or built-in web search flows, it reduces latency, avoids heavy reasoning overhead, adds schema-validated tool calls, rotates multiple API keys automatically, and enables zero-build TypeScript deployment for practical agentic search and web research workflows.

metadata.name: grok2api
metadata.description: 面向 Grok Build、Grok Web 与 Grok Console 的多账号 API 网关

summary.zh: Grok2API 是面向 Grok Web 的兼容网关，基于 FastAPI 将对话、图像与视频能力转换为 OpenAI/Anthropic 风格接口，适合统一接入现有 AI 应用。其亮点是多账号池调度、流式响应、工具透传、用量统计，以及内置后台与 WebUI，兼顾部署效率和运营管理。
summary.en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that exposes Grok Web capabilities through OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible APIs, making it easy to plug Grok into existing AI applications and SDK workflows. It supports chat, image generation and editing, and video generation, while adding practical platform features such as streaming responses, tool-call passthrough, unified usage tracking, multi-account pool management, proxy support, local media caching, and built-in admin and web UI components for operations and end-user access.

metadata.name: best-skills
metadata.description: 通用高质量 Skills 合集🔥

summary.zh: 该仓库汇集面向 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等智能体的高质量 Skills，通过关键词与场景描述实现自动触发，覆盖论文写作、公众号内容、PPT、Draw.io/Excalidraw 制图等任务。其核心亮点是将可复用工作流封装为标准 SKILL.md，降低手动提示成本，提升多场景内容生产与知识表达效率。
summary.en: This repository curates high-quality reusable skills for agent tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. Unlike manual prompts, each skill is packaged as a structured `SKILL.md` that agents can invoke automatically based on task description and trigger context. It targets practical content and knowledge-work scenarios, including thesis writing, WeChat article production, presentation generation, and Draw.io or Excalidraw diagram creation. Its main value is turning repeatable expert workflows into portable, installable automation assets that reduce prompt overhead and improve consistency, speed, and output quality across multiple agent-driven tasks.

metadata.name: UltimateSearchSkill
metadata.description: Dual-engine web search Skill for OpenClaw/Pi: Grok AI + Tavily + FireCrawl

summary.zh: 该仓库为 OpenClaw/Pi 提供纯 Shell 实现的双引擎 Web 搜索技能，结合 Grok、Tavily 与 FireCrawl 完成并行检索、交叉验证和失败降级，适合为 AI Agent 提供低依赖、可审计且更可靠的联网搜索与网页抓取能力。
summary.en: This repository delivers a dual-engine web search skill for OpenClaw and Pi agents, implemented entirely in Shell without MCP dependencies. It combines Grok through OpenAI-compatible endpoints with Tavily for structured retrieval, then uses parallel querying and cross-validation to improve answer reliability. For content fetching, it falls back from Tavily Extract to FireCrawl Scrape, providing resilient page access. The project is well suited for agentic workflows that need auditable, lightweight, self-hostable web search and retrieval with simple Docker-based deployment and secure local-first operational controls.

metadata.name: config_GUI
metadata.description: 对codex的config做一个简单的可视化

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Windows 的 Codex CLI 配置可视化工具，用 Rust 构建桌面 GUI，帮助用户安全编辑 `config.toml`。它支持三态布尔、数组与 TOML 片段输入、从文件导入、保存预览及合并保存，能在保留未知配置项的同时降低手改配置出错成本，适合本地开发环境配置管理。
summary.en: This repository provides a Windows desktop GUI for visually editing Codex CLI's `config.toml`, built in Rust. It focuses on safer local configuration management by treating empty fields as unset, supporting merge-save behavior to preserve unknown entries, and offering import, preview, enum hints, and TOML-fragment editing for complex values. The tool is especially useful for developers who want to avoid manual TOML mistakes while managing Codex settings in a more accessible and structured interface.

metadata.name: jshookmcp
metadata.description: js hook toolkit that all you need

summary.zh: jshookmcp 是面向 AI 智能体的 JavaScript 安全分析与逆向工具平台，以 MCP 服务器形态聚合数百工具，覆盖浏览器自动化、CDP 调试、网络拦截、AST 转换、WASM 逆向与内存取证。其分层激活、混合检索与运行时恢复机制，兼顾上下文效率、扩展性与复杂工作流编排。
summary.en: jshookmcp is an MCP server built for AI agents that unifies hundreds of tools for JavaScript analysis, security research, and reverse engineering. It spans browser automation, CDP debugging, network interception, AST transformation, source-map recovery, WASM reversing, and process or memory forensics in one runtime. Its main strengths are progressive tool tiers for token efficiency, hybrid search over tool schemas, runtime session recovery, and a plugin-friendly architecture that supports extensible, multi-step investigation workflows.

metadata.name: llmdoc
metadata.description: TokenRoll LLMDoc for Coding Agent

summary.zh: llmdoc 是面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的文档驱动工作流插件，统一初始化、更新与知识沉淀流程。它以轻量核心技能配合参考协议、子代理与插件接口，支持按任务复杂度选择 fast、analysis、full 模式，适合编码代理在协作开发中持续维护架构文档、约束规则与项目记忆。
summary.en: llmdoc is a doc-driven workflow plugin for Claude Code and Codex that standardizes repository initialization, documentation updates, and long-term project knowledge capture. It uses a small public interface backed by reusable skills, references, subagents, and plugin hooks, keeping operational guidance out of duplicated command layers. Its update flow supports fast, analysis, and full modes, allowing coding agents to maintain architecture docs, rules, reflections, and stable contracts with effort matched to task complexity.

metadata.name: ClawDeckX
metadata.description: Complexity within, simplicity without. 繁于内，简于形。

summary.zh: ClawDeckX 是面向 OpenClaw 的开源可视化管理平台，以跨平台 Web 界面简化 AI 智能体的安装、配置、监控与优化。其亮点是类 macOS 交互、向导式初始化、深度参数编辑、多语言支持，以及本地与远程网关统一管理和实时观测能力。
summary.en: ClawDeckX is an open-source visual management platform for OpenClaw that simplifies AI agent installation, configuration, monitoring, and optimization through a cross-platform web interface. It targets beginners while still exposing deep control over model switching, memory, plugins, and routing. Key strengths include a macOS-inspired UI, guided setup flows, real-time observability, responsive multi-device support, multilingual architecture, and unified management of both local and remote gateways across development and operations environments.

metadata.name: airi
metadata.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.

summary.zh: AIRI 是面向个人部署的 AI 虚拟伴侣平台，聚焦语音实时对话、角色人格承载与跨世界互动。项目支持 Web、macOS、Windows，并扩展到 Minecraft、Factorio 等游戏场景。其亮点在于自托管、角色化 AI 体验、多端接入与实时语音能力，适合构建 AI 主播、虚拟陪伴和可交互数字角色。
summary.en: AIRI is a self-hosted AI companion platform designed for creating interactive virtual characters with persistent personality and real-time voice conversation. It targets users who want an owned, cross-platform alternative for AI companionship, VTuber-style agents, and game-integrated characters. The project supports Web, macOS, and Windows, and can interact with environments such as Minecraft and Factorio. Its main strengths are self-hosting, real-time multimodal interaction, strong character embodiment, and multi-platform deployment for consumer-facing AI experiences.

metadata.name: PUAClaw
metadata.description: Claw 们终将接管世界，PUAClaw is All You Need

summary.zh: PUAClaw 是一个以戏谑学术风格整理 LLM 提示说服术的开源知识库，围绕 PPE-T 分类体系收录 16 大类、96 项技术模板、兼容性矩阵与风险分级。适用于提示工程研究、AI Agent 行为分析与安全讨论，亮点在于标准化 taxonomy、多语言文档与案例化索引。
summary.en: PUAClaw is an open-source, satire-styled knowledge base for cataloging persuasive prompt techniques used with large language models. It organizes the space through a standardized PPE-T taxonomy covering 16 major categories and 96 sub-techniques, with prompt templates, compatibility matrices, risk ratings, and case references. The repository is useful for prompt engineering research, AI agent behavior analysis, and safety discussion. Its main strengths are structured documentation, multilingual coverage, and a searchable framework for studying unconventional prompting patterns rather than deploying them in production.

metadata.name: TavilyProxyManager
metadata.description: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。

summary.zh: TavilyProxyManager 是面向 Tavily API 的透明反向代理与密钥池管理工具，用 Master Key 统一聚合多个 Tavily Key 的额度，对外保持官方接口兼容。系统具备按剩余额度优选、限流场景自动切换、MCP 接入支持及内置可视化面板，可管理密钥、监控用量与审计请求日志。采用 Go 单文件服务与 Vue 3 Web UI，适合 AI 搜索服务聚合、团队共享调用与运维管控。
summary.en: TavilyProxyManager is a transparent reverse proxy and key-pool manager for the Tavily API. It aggregates multiple Tavily API keys behind a single master key while preserving compatibility with the official API. The system adds credit-aware key selection, automatic failover on rate-limit or auth errors, built-in MCP support, and a Web UI for key management, usage analytics, and request logging. Built as a single-binary Go service with a Vue 3 admin frontend, it fits shared AI search access, team-level quota orchestration, and lightweight operations control.

metadata.name: openpencil
metadata.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.

summary.zh: OpenPencil 是面向 UI/产品设计的开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持将自然语言直接生成到实时画布，并用并发 Agent 团队拆解复杂页面协同设计。其以 Design-as-Code 为核心，采用可读可版本化的 .op JSON 格式，支持多模型适配、MCP 接入及 React/Tailwind、HTML/CSS 导出，适合 AI 驱动的界面原型、设计协作与开发交付。
summary.en: OpenPencil is an open-source, AI-native vector design tool built for UI and product design workflows. It turns natural-language prompts directly into live canvas output and uses concurrent agent teams to decompose and generate complex page sections in parallel. Centered on a Design-as-Code approach, it stores work in readable, version-friendly `.op` JSON files and supports multi-model orchestration, MCP integration, and export to React + Tailwind or HTML + CSS. It is well suited for AI-driven prototyping, interface generation, and design-to-development handoff.

metadata.name: awesome-openclaw-usecases
metadata.description: A community collection of OpenClaw use cases for making life easier.

summary.zh: 该仓库汇集 OpenClaw 真实落地案例，聚焦降低 AI 代理采用门槛，帮助用户快速找到可改善日常、内容生产与运维流程的具体玩法。亮点在于覆盖社媒摘要、自动化创作、多代理协作、视频编辑与 DevOps 编排，并明确提示社区技能的安全审查风险。
summary.en: This repository is a curated community list of real-world OpenClaw use cases, focused on solving adoption friction by showing how AI agents can create practical value in everyday workflows. It highlights concrete scenarios across social media digests, content production, multi-agent collaboration, natural-language video editing, and infrastructure orchestration. Its main strength is turning an abstract agent platform into actionable patterns users can reuse, while also calling out the security risks of unaudited community skills, plugins, and third-party dependencies.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: 该项目面向 GitHub Stars 管理，自动抓取账号收藏仓库，读取 README 并调用兼容 OpenAI 的模型生成摘要与高权重标签。其亮点在于增量更新、标签归一化治理、并发处理，以及通过 Jinja2 输出 Markdown 和静态检索页，可选同步到 GitHub Pages 与 Obsidian，适合个人技术收藏归档与知识检索。
summary.en: GitHub Stars Index automates the collection and organization of starred repositories for a GitHub account. It fetches repo metadata, reads README files, and uses OpenAI-compatible models to generate concise summaries and normalized high-signal tags for search and review. Key strengths include incremental syncing, tag governance to reduce synonym noise, concurrent AI processing, and Jinja2-based Markdown and static HTML output. It can also publish to GitHub Pages or sync into Obsidian, making it well suited for personal curation, technical bookmarking, and searchable knowledge management.

metadata.name: x-feed-digest
metadata.description: Transform your X/Twitter following list into AI-curated daily digest

summary.zh: 该项目将 X/Twitter 关注列表转为 AI 筛选的日报：上传关注 CSV 后，系统并发抓取过去24小时推文，借助 Grok 获取实时内容、Claude 生成编辑级分类摘要。采用 FastAPI + Vue 3 架构，支持任务历史、进度追踪与结果下载，适合信息密集型用户高效获取高价值动态。
summary.en: X Feed Digest turns a user's X/Twitter following list into an AI-curated daily briefing. After uploading an exported CSV, it fetches tweets from the last 24 hours in parallel through Grok's real-time X access, then uses Claude to produce an editor-style, categorized digest. Built with FastAPI and Vue 3, it provides job history, live progress tracking, and downloadable outputs, making it useful for researchers, builders, investors, and heavy information consumers who need a faster way to surface high-value updates.

metadata.name: waoowaoo
metadata.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.

summary.zh: waoowaoo 是面向短剧、漫画视频与真人影视的工业级 AI 影视生产平台，可从小说文本自动完成剧本解析、角色场景生成、分镜编排、配音与视频合成，强调角色一致性、流程可控性与接近好莱坞标准的全流程创作协同。
summary.en: waoowaoo is an industrial-grade AI film and video production platform built for short dramas, comic videos, and live-action content. It turns novel text into structured scripts, characters, scenes, storyboards, voice tracks, and finished videos in one workflow. Its core value lies in controllable end-to-end production, consistent character and scene generation, and a studio-oriented pipeline that brings professional, Hollywood-style AI creation into a practical web-based product.

metadata.name: gemini-business2api
metadata.description: OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini Business with multi-account load balancing and multimodal capabilities (image/video generation, file parsing) | 将 Gemini Business 转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡及多模态能力（图像生成、视频生成、解析文件）

summary.zh: 该项目将 Gemini Business 封装为 OpenAI 兼容 API 网关，面向需要统一接入大模型能力的团队与开发者。其亮点在于多账户负载均衡、后台可视化管理，以及文本、文件、图像、视频等多模态能力整合，支持 Docker 部署并兼容 SQLite/PostgreSQL。
summary.en: Gemini Business2API turns Gemini Business into an OpenAI-compatible API gateway for teams and developers who want a unified way to consume Gemini capabilities. Its core strengths are multi-account load balancing, a built-in admin console, and integrated multimodal workflows covering text, file parsing, image generation and editing, and video generation. Built with FastAPI and Vue 3, it supports Docker-based deployment, centralized configuration, operational monitoring, and both SQLite and PostgreSQL, making it practical for stable production-style access management and model service orchestration.

metadata.name: threejs-capacitor-ios-game
metadata.description: A vibe coded mobile point and click adventure game  using agent skills.

summary.zh: 该仓库是面向 Three.js 与 Capacitor iOS 的3D点击冒险游戏参考模板，提供 Claude Code/Codex 技能、分步提示词与角色动画索引规范，帮助开发者以 AI 辅助方式快速搭建跨端场景、角色加载、动画编排与移动端集成流程。
summary.en: This repository is a reference template for building a mobile point-and-click 3D adventure game with Three.js and Capacitor for iOS. Instead of shipping a runnable app, it provides reusable agent skills for Claude Code and Codex CLI, step-by-step AI prompts for generating characters, backgrounds, voices, and scenes, plus a JSON animation index that defines a clean contract for GLB-based character animation. Its main value is accelerating AI-assisted cross-platform game prototyping, scene assembly, animation wiring, and iOS integration workflows.

metadata.name: playwright-skill
metadata.description: Claude Code Skill for browser automation with Playwright. Model-invoked - Claude autonomously writes and executes custom automation for testing and validation.

summary.zh: 该仓库将 Playwright 封装为 Claude Code 可调用技能，使模型按需生成并执行浏览器自动化脚本，适用于网页测试、流程验证与多步骤操作。其亮点在于插件化分发、渐进式能力加载、默认可视化浏览器执行，以及通用执行器与安全临时文件清理机制，降低集成和运行出错成本。
summary.en: This repository packages Playwright as a Claude Code skill, allowing the model to generate and run browser automation dynamically for testing, validation, and multi-step web workflows. Instead of relying on fixed scripts, Claude writes task-specific automation on demand. Key strengths include plugin-based distribution, progressive capability loading, visible-browser execution by default, a universal executor that avoids module-resolution issues, and safe temporary-file cleanup. It is well suited for teams that want flexible browser automation integrated directly into AI-assisted development and QA workflows.

metadata.name: superpowers
metadata.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

summary.zh: Superpowers 是面向编码智能体的开发方法论与技能框架，围绕需求澄清、分段评审、实现规划和子代理执行构建完整流程。它强调 TDD、YAGNI 与 DRY，可接入 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等多种代理环境，提升自动化研发的稳定性、可控性与持续自治能力。
summary.en: Superpowers is an agentic development methodology and composable skills framework for coding agents. It structures the workflow from requirement clarification and design review to implementation planning and subagent-driven execution. With strong emphasis on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY, it integrates with Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other agent runtimes to improve autonomous software delivery, control, and engineering reliability.

metadata.name: directory-migration-tool
metadata.description: 一个使用符号链接迁移大型目录的 Windows 工具，快速将文件夹迁移到其他磁盘，且保留原路径，使程序正常运行，解决原磁盘空间不足的问题

summary.zh: 这是一款面向 Windows 的目录迁移工具，通过符号链接把大型文件夹无感迁移到其他磁盘，缓解系统盘容量压力。项目同时提供 PowerShell CLI 与 WPF GUI，结合 robocopy 镜像复制、空间校验、关键路径保护、自动回滚与修复/还原能力，适合个人电脑和运维场景进行安全迁移。
summary.en: Directory Migration Tool is a Windows utility that transparently moves large folders to another drive while preserving the original path through directory symlinks. It targets disk-space relief without breaking application behavior. The project offers both a PowerShell CLI and a WPF GUI, and combines `robocopy`-based mirrored transfer with path validation, free-space checks, rollback, restore, and repair modes. Its core strength is safe, reversible directory relocation for personal workstations and practical Windows maintenance workflows.

metadata.name: skills-hub
metadata.description: A cross-platform desktop app to manage Agent Skills in one place and sync them to multiple AI coding tools’ global skills directories — “Install once, sync everywhere”.

summary.zh: Skills Hub 是基于 Tauri 与 React 的跨平台桌面应用，集中管理 Agent Skills，并同步到 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等多种 AI 编码工具。它支持全局/项目级作用域、符号链接优先同步、现有技能迁移、在线检索安装与多来源导入，显著降低多工具协作下的技能分发与维护成本。
summary.en: Skills Hub is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri and React for centralized management of Agent Skills across multiple AI coding tools. It supports global and project-level sync, prefers symlink or junction-based distribution with copy fallback, and streamlines migration from existing tool directories. With online skill discovery, one-click install, multi-source import, tagging, and update propagation, it reduces the operational overhead of maintaining reusable skills consistently across environments such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other agent-driven developer tools.

metadata.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
metadata.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供单文件CLAUDE.md规范，将Karpathy对大模型编码缺陷的观察提炼为四原则，帮助Claude Code先澄清假设、避免过度设计、实施最小改动，并以测试和可验证目标驱动交付，适合代码代理调优与团队开发规范统一。
summary.en: This repository packages a single CLAUDE.md guideline file for Claude Code, turning Andrej Karpathy's observations about LLM coding failures into four operational principles: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, and goal-driven execution. Its value is highly practical: it reduces wrong assumptions, overengineering, and collateral edits while steering agents toward testable outcomes. The project is suited to teams or individual developers who want a lightweight prompt-layer standard to tune coding agents, improve review quality, and make automated code changes more predictable and verifiable.

metadata.name: get-shit-done
metadata.description: A light-weight and powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system for Claude Code by TÂCHES.

summary.zh: 该仓库为 Claude Code 提供轻量但功能完整的元提示、上下文工程与规范驱动开发框架，面向 AI 编码协作、任务拆解与流程约束场景。当前仓库已归档，核心价值在于用结构化规范提升代理式开发的一致性、可控性与执行效率。
summary.en: This repository presents a lightweight yet capable system for Claude Code centered on meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development. It targets AI-assisted coding workflows where task decomposition, structured guidance, and execution discipline matter. Its main technical value is using explicit specifications and contextual scaffolding to improve consistency, controllability, and delivery speed in agent-driven software development. The repository itself is now archived and serves mainly as a redirect to the actively maintained GSD Core project in the Open GSD organization.

metadata.name: Practical-Guide-to-Context-Engineering
metadata.description: 大模型应用开发的方向，上下文工程是设计原则，Agent Harness 是构建目标，本项目的目标，是为开发者和研究者提供一份大模型应用开发的骨架思路

summary.zh: 该仓库围绕大模型应用开发，提出“上下文工程+Harness Engineering”骨架方法，系统梳理上下文构建、RAG、记忆、提示与评估的关系，帮助开发者为 Agent 设计稳定运行空间，提升复杂业务场景中的推理质量、可控性与落地效率。
summary.en: This repository is a practical guide to building LLM applications around two ideas: Context Engineering as the design principle and Harness Engineering as the execution target. It explains how to select, organize, and inject the most relevant context within limited windows, then extend that into a stable agent runtime with capabilities, collaboration patterns, memory, evaluation, and feedback loops. Instead of treating RAG or prompting as isolated tricks, it frames them as connected parts of a broader architecture for developers and researchers building domain-specific AI systems.

metadata.name: droid-resource-manager
metadata.description: A desktop manager for MCP, Skills, and Droids resources

summary.zh: Droid Resource Manager 是面向 MCP、Droids、Skills 等 AI 资源的桌面统一管理工具，支持创建、编辑、拖拽整理、导入导出与手动扫描刷新。项目基于 Electron、React、Vite 构建，覆盖全局与项目级资源目录，适合本地 AI 工作流配置维护与资源市场化管理。
summary.en: Droid Resource Manager is a desktop application for centrally managing MCP, Droids, Skills, Prompts, and Rules resources in local AI workflows. Built with Electron, React, and Vite, it provides creation, editing, drag-and-drop organization, import/export, and manual resource scanning across both global and project-level directories. Its main value is turning scattered configuration assets into a unified operational workspace, making AI resource maintenance, discovery, and reuse more efficient for developers and teams.

metadata.name: pyCapCut
metadata.description: A lightweight, flexible, and easy-to-use Python tool for generating and exporting CapCut drafts to build fully automated video editing/remix pipelines! Another similar project: https://github.com/GuanYixuan/pyJianYingDraft

summary.zh: pyCapCut 是面向 CapCut 草稿生成与导出的轻量 Python 工具，适合自动化视频剪辑、混剪与批量生产流程。它支持模板草稿复用、素材替换、字幕导入、多轨道编排、关键帧、特效滤镜与批量导出，在保留 CapCut 编辑能力的同时提升脚本化生产效率。
summary.en: pyCapCut is a lightweight Python toolkit for generating and exporting CapCut drafts in automated video editing and remix pipelines. It targets creators and developers who need scriptable draft assembly, template reuse, batch export, subtitle import, and programmable control over tracks, keyframes, effects, filters, transitions, and text styling. Its main strength is turning CapCut's GUI-centric workflow into a flexible code-driven production pipeline while preserving compatibility with complex draft-based editing scenarios.

metadata.name: desktop-cc-gui
metadata.description: CC GUI Client (VibeCoding Platform Designed for Developers)

summary.zh: Desktop CC GUI 是面向开发者的跨平台本地优先 AI 工程工作台，整合多种代码引擎、终端、Git、任务执行与项目记忆。基于 Tauri 2、React 19 与 TypeScript，强调开发过程可观测、可恢复、可审计，适用于 AI 辅助编码、项目治理与复杂研发协作场景。
summary.en: Desktop CC GUI is a cross-platform, local-first AI engineering workbench built for professional developers. It unifies multiple coding engines, terminal access, Git workflows, task execution, project memory, and governance panels in one native desktop client. Built with Tauri 2, React 19, TypeScript, and Vite, it emphasizes observability, recoverability, and auditability over opaque chat-only experiences. It is well suited for AI-assisted coding, project intelligence, controlled execution, and collaborative software delivery across complex development environments.

metadata.name: MiniMax-MCP
metadata.description: Official MiniMax Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables interaction with powerful Text to Speech, image generation and video generation APIs.

summary.zh: MiniMax-MCP 是官方 MCP 服务器，将 MiniMax 的文本转语音、图像生成和视频生成能力标准化封装给兼容客户端调用。它适合智能体、工作流编排与创作工具快速接入多模态生成 API，亮点在于统一协议、官方维护与低集成成本。
summary.en: MiniMax-MCP is the official Model Context Protocol server for exposing MiniMax text-to-speech, image generation, and video generation APIs through a standardized interface. It is well suited for AI agents, workflow orchestration, and creative tools that need fast multimodal model integration, with key strengths in protocol unification, official support, and low-friction API access.

metadata.name: dexter
metadata.description: An autonomous agent for deep financial research

summary.zh: Dexter 是面向金融投研的自治智能体，基于大模型完成复杂问题拆解、工具选择、自我反思与结果校验，结合实时财报和市场数据生成可追踪的深度研究结论，并内置循环检测与步数限制，适用于金融分析辅助、研究自动化与教学演示，而非真实投资决策执行。
summary.en: Dexter is an autonomous agent built for deep financial research rather than general coding workflows. It uses large language models to break down complex questions, plan research steps, call the right tools, and iteratively validate its own findings. By combining self-reflection with real-time financial statements and market data, it produces traceable, data-backed analysis. Safety features such as loop detection and step limits help control autonomous execution. It is well suited for research automation, financial analysis assistance, and educational experimentation, not for live trading or investment advice.

metadata.name: grok-skill
metadata.description: Codex skill: aggressive web research via OpenAI-compatible Grok endpoint (2api)

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 Codex/Claude 的联网检索技能，借助 OpenAI 兼容的 Grok/2api 接口完成实时网页研究。核心价值在于把版本核验、文档查询、故障排查等时效性任务接入代理工作流，并以结构化 JSON 返回答案与来源，兼顾可配置性、安全密钥管理和一键安装体验。
summary.en: This repository delivers a web research skill for Codex and Claude, using an OpenAI-compatible Grok endpoint such as 2api to fetch real-time information. Its main value is integrating time-sensitive tasks like version checks, documentation lookup, troubleshooting, and current status queries directly into agent workflows. The project emphasizes practical adoption with structured JSON responses containing synthesized content and sources, environment-based configuration, local secret overrides, and straightforward PowerShell installation for quick setup and repeatable use.

metadata.name: cloudflare_temp_email
metadata.description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot

summary.zh: 该项目基于 Cloudflare Workers 等免费能力，搭建可低成本部署的临时邮箱服务，支持邮件收发、附件、IMAP/SMTP 与 Telegram Bot 集成。其亮点是采用 Rust WASM 提升邮件解析性能，配备现代化多语言界面、独立地址密码机制，并对 AI Agent 场景提供友好支持。
summary.en: This repository provides a full-featured temporary email service built on Cloudflare's free infrastructure, enabling low-cost deployment for disposable domain mailboxes. It supports sending and receiving emails, attachments, IMAP/SMTP access, and Telegram Bot integration. Key strengths include high-performance mail parsing with Rust WASM, a modern multilingual responsive UI, per-address password protection, and built-in support for AI agent workflows that need programmatic mailbox access.

metadata.name: claude-code-best-practice
metadata.description: from vibe coding to agentic engineering - practice makes claude perfect

summary.zh: 该仓库围绕 Claude Code 构建系统化最佳实践，覆盖子代理、命令、技能、工作流、Hooks 与 MCP 配置，帮助团队从随意提示式开发转向可复用、可编排、可落地的智能体工程。适用于提升协作开发效率、沉淀规范与构建自动化工程流程。
summary.en: This repository codifies best practices for Claude Code, covering subagents, slash commands, skills, workflows, hooks, and MCP server configuration. Its core value is turning ad hoc prompt-driven coding into reusable, orchestrated agentic engineering patterns that teams can actually implement. It is useful for developers and engineering teams who want standardized AI-assisted workflows, stronger automation, better maintainability, and a practical reference for building production-ready Claude Code setups.

metadata.name: oh-my-claudecode
metadata.description: Teams-first Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code

summary.zh: oh-my-claudecode 面向团队协作，围绕 Claude Code 提供多智能体编排能力，以插件与 CLI 形式快速接入。它强调零学习成本，通过预置工作流、命令体系与可迁移配置，提升多人开发、任务分派和工程自动化效率。
summary.en: oh-my-claudecode is a teams-first orchestration layer for Claude Code that brings multi-agent coordination to everyday engineering work with almost no learning curve. Delivered as both a plugin and CLI, it streamlines setup, task delegation, and reusable workflows for collaborative coding. Its core value lies in turning Claude Code into a more structured team tool through agent orchestration, command-driven automation, and portable configuration, making it practical for shared development environments and repeatable engineering operations.

metadata.name: openclaw-mini
metadata.description: 🦞 OpenClaw 核心架构的极简复现，涵盖 sessionKey 会话域、队列串行、工具化记忆检索、按需上下文加载、可扩展技能与主动心跳唤醒机制

summary.zh: OpenClaw Mini 是对 OpenClaw 核心架构的极简复现，面向 AI Agent 系统设计学习。项目聚焦会话持久化、上下文裁剪压缩、工具化记忆检索、技能扩展与主动心跳唤醒，并通过 CLI 与 WebSocket Gateway 展示从单机交互到网络化服务的完整最小闭环。
summary.en: OpenClaw Mini is a compact reimplementation of the core OpenClaw architecture for learning system-level AI agent design. Rather than focusing only on a simple agent loop, it demonstrates a complete minimal stack with session persistence, context loading and pruning, event-driven execution, tool-based memory retrieval, extensible skills, and proactive heartbeat wake-up. It also includes a CLI and WebSocket gateway to show how a local agent can evolve into a networked service while keeping the codebase small, readable, and architecture-oriented.

metadata.name: Trellis
metadata.description: The best agent harness.

summary.zh: Trellis 是面向 AI 编程的智能体工程框架，通过将规范、任务与项目记忆持久化到仓库，让不同 AI 编码平台共享统一上下文与团队标准。它适用于代码协作、需求实现和评审流程，突出自动注入规格、任务化工作流、多平台兼容及可复用工程记忆，减少重复提示并提升交付一致性。
summary.en: Trellis is an engineering framework for AI-assisted coding that persists specs, tasks, and project memory directly in the repository, giving coding agents durable context across sessions. It is built for structured implementation, review, and team collaboration, helping organizations enforce shared standards instead of repeating prompts. Its main strengths are auto-injected specs, task-centered workflows, reusable project memory, and support for multiple AI coding platforms.

metadata.name: awesome-rsshub-routes
metadata.description: 🎯 精选 RSSHub 实用路由推荐，让你的 RSS 阅读更高效！

summary.zh: 该仓库汇集官方RSS与RSSHub高价值路由，提供在线检索、分类筛选、OPML一键导入和自动可用性巡检。适合构建高效信息订阅流，快速发现AI、技术社区、新闻等信源，并借助GitHub Pages与工作流持续维护目录质量。
summary.en: This repository is a practical directory of official RSS feeds and curated RSSHub routes, built to streamline feed discovery and subscription management. It offers online browsing with category filtering, one-click OPML import, and automated feed health checks that expose broken links through GitHub Issues.
