The project is well suited for users who want to build a high-signal reading workflow across AI, tech communities, news, and media sources, while leveraging GitHub Pages and GitHub Actions to keep the catalog accessible, searchable, and continuously maintained.

metadata.name: GoSubTTS
metadata.description: 一款打开即用的具有配音生成、字幕提取等功能的桌面app

summary.zh: GoSubTTS 是基于 Wails 与 Go 的跨平台桌面应用，聚焦本地智能配音与字幕提取。它集成 EdgeTTS、Whisper.cpp 和 FFmpeg，支持离线转写、同步生成字幕、音视频多格式导入及 Windows GPU、macOS Metal 加速，主打零配置、隐私安全与开箱即用。
summary.en: GoSubTTS is a cross-platform desktop app built with Go and Wails for local voice dubbing and subtitle extraction. It combines Microsoft EdgeTTS, Whisper.cpp, and FFmpeg to provide high-quality text-to-speech, synchronized subtitle generation, and offline speech-to-text from common audio and video formats. The app emphasizes zero-configuration usability, privacy-first local processing, and strong performance through Windows GPU acceleration and native macOS Metal support, making it practical for creators, subtitle workflows, and lightweight media post-production.

metadata.name: GrokSearch
metadata.description: Integrate Grok's powerful real-time search capabilities into Claude via the MCP protocol!

summary.zh: Grok Search MCP 是面向 Claude Code 等客户端的实时联网增强方案，基于 FastMCP 将 Grok 智能搜索、Tavily 抓取与站点映射、Firecrawl 降级兜底整合到统一 MCP 服务中。项目支持 OpenAI 兼容接口、时间上下文注入、重试退避和父进程监控，适合提升大模型检索外部知识、获取官方文档与降低幻觉率。
summary.en: Grok Search MCP is a FastMCP-based MCP server that brings stronger real-time web access to Claude Code and similar LLM clients. It combines Grok for AI-driven search, Tavily for high-fidelity page extraction and site mapping, and Firecrawl as a fallback when extraction fails. With OpenAI-compatible endpoints, automatic time-context injection, retry and backoff handling, and parent-process monitoring, it is designed to improve external knowledge retrieval, access authoritative documentation, and reduce hallucinations in coding and research workflows.

metadata.name: huobao-drama
metadata.description: 🎬 火宝短剧 - 基于AI的一站式短剧生成平台 《一句话生成完整短剧，从剧本到成片全自动化》  Huobao Drama - An AI-Powered End-to-End Short Drama Generator "One Sentence to Complete Drama: Fully Automated from Script to Final Video"

summary.zh: 火宝短剧是面向短视频创作的AI自动化平台，基于TypeScript全栈与Mastra Agents，串联剧本改写、角色/场景提取、分镜生成、配音、图生视频和FFmpeg合成。支持多厂商模型接入与本地资源管理，适合低成本批量生产短剧成片。
summary.en: Huobao Drama is an AI-powered platform for automated short-drama production, built with a TypeScript full-stack architecture and Mastra Agents. It connects script rewriting, character and scene extraction, storyboard generation, voice assignment, image-to-video creation, and FFmpeg-based final assembly into one workflow. With support for multiple model providers, SQLite-backed asset management, and end-to-end production from a single prompt to finished video, it is suited for creators and teams that need scalable, lower-cost short-form video generation with minimal manual editing.

metadata.name: universal-db-mcp
metadata.description: 通用数据库 MCP 连接器：支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、MongoDB 等 17 种数据库，支持 Claude Desktop、Cursor、Windsurf、VS Code、ChatGPT 等 50+ 平台，用自然语言查询和分析数据

summary.zh: Universal DB MCP 是面向 AI 助手的通用数据库连接器，基于 MCP 与 HTTP API 打通自然语言到数据库查询分析流程。其支持 17 种数据库、50 多个平台，具备只读安全、敏感数据脱敏、多模式接入、Schema 缓存与批量优化等能力，适合企业数据问答、辅助分析与跨库统一接入。
summary.en: Universal DB MCP is a universal database connector that links AI assistants to databases through the Model Context Protocol and HTTP APIs, enabling natural-language querying and analysis without writing SQL manually. It supports 17 databases and more than 50 platforms, including Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and ChatGPT. Key strengths include read-only safety by default, sensitive data masking, flexible MCP and REST access modes, schema caching, and large-scale schema retrieval optimization, making it well suited for enterprise data Q&A, analytics assistance, and unified cross-database access.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Agent skills for Vue 3 development

summary.zh: 该仓库面向 Vue 3 开发场景，提供可被 AI 编程助手调用的技能库，覆盖 Composition API、Router、Pinia、测试、调试与可复用 composable 设计。其价值在于把真实问题沉淀为结构化提示与最佳实践，提升生成代码的准确性、一致性和工程可维护性。
summary.en: This repository provides a skill library for AI coding agents focused on Vue 3 development. It packages best practices for the Composition API, Vue Router, Pinia, testing, debugging, JSX, and reusable composable design into structured, triggerable skills. Its core value is turning real-world Vue issues into reusable guidance that improves code accuracy, framework-specific correctness, consistency, and maintainability. It is especially useful for agent-assisted coding workflows where generic LLM output often misses Vue-specific patterns, edge cases, and performance or SSR considerations.

metadata.name: daily_stock_analysis
metadata.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。  LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向A股、港股与美股的LLM驱动股票分析系统，聚合行情、新闻、公告与资金面等多源数据，生成含评分、趋势、买卖点和风险提示的决策仪表盘，并支持Web/桌面工作台、Agent问股及多渠道自动推送，适合低成本定时投研与自选股跟踪。
summary.en: This repository is an LLM-powered stock analysis platform for A-share, Hong Kong, and US markets. It aggregates multi-source market data, news, announcements, and capital-flow signals to produce decision dashboards with ratings, trends, entry and exit levels, and risk alerts. It also includes web and desktop workspaces, agent-based interactive stock analysis, and multi-channel automated delivery. The project is well suited for low-cost scheduled research, watchlist monitoring, and AI-assisted investment decision support.

metadata.name: QuantDinger
metadata.description: AI quantitative trading platform for crypto, stocks, and forex with backtesting, live trading, market data, and multi-agent research.vibe-trading ,trading-agents,ai-trader,ai-trading

summary.zh: QuantDinger 是面向加密货币、股票与外汇的开源 AI 量化交易平台，覆盖策略生成、回测、模拟盘、实盘执行与监控全流程。其亮点在于将多智能体研究、Python 策略开发、自托管部署及市场数据接入整合为统一基础设施，适合研究驱动型量化团队快速验证并落地交易想法。
summary.en: QuantDinger is an open-source AI quant trading platform for crypto, equities, and forex, covering the full workflow from idea generation and strategy coding to backtesting, paper trading, live execution, and monitoring. Its core value is a unified self-hosted infrastructure that combines multi-agent research, Python-based strategy development, and market data integration in one stack. It is well suited for research-driven quant teams that need to rapidly validate trading ideas and move them into production with less tooling fragmentation.

metadata.name: github-skill-forge
metadata.description: 一个"制造技能的技能"。这个工具自动化了将任意 GitHub 仓库转换为标准化技能的全过程，是扩展 AI Agent 能力的核心工具。

summary.zh: GitHub Skill Forge 通过 GitHub API 零克隆扫描仓库，自动提炼核心代码与文档并生成标准化技能包，供 AI Agent 直接理解和调用。它结合 Smart RAG、镜像轮换与质量初筛，适合快速接入开源项目、辅助代码修改、运行分析与能力扩展。
summary.en: GitHub Skill Forge turns any GitHub repository into a standardized skill package that AI agents can directly understand and invoke. Instead of cloning code locally, it scans repositories through the GitHub API, extracts the most relevant code and documentation, and builds an AI-ready context bundle. With Smart RAG-style filtering, API mirror rotation, multithreaded fetching, and basic project quality screening, it is well suited for onboarding open-source projects, accelerating code assistance, and extending AI agent capabilities with reusable repository intelligence.

summary.zh: GudaStudio Commands 是面向 Claude Code 的自定义命令集，核心以 RPI（Research-Plan-Implementation）流程组织复杂开发任务，并结合 OpenSpec、多模型协作与人工分阶段清理上下文，提升长时编码稳定性。项目适用于复杂需求分析、计划拆解和生产级实现，支持跨平台安装，并可联动 MCP 工具验证环境与增强代码检索能力。
summary.en: GudaStudio Commands is a custom command suite for Claude Code focused on handling complex, long-running software tasks through an RPI workflow: Research, Plan, and Implementation. It integrates OpenSpec, multi-model collaboration, and human-guided context partitioning to maximize effective context usage and reduce decision drift. The project is suited for requirement analysis, execution planning, and production-grade coding, with cross-platform installation and MCP-based environment validation and code retrieval support.

metadata.name: XHS_Business_Idea_Validator
metadata.description: 小红书收集和分析数据来解析市场需求用户痛点及竞争格局 - 📊 **小红书数据抓取**: 自动抓取相关笔记和评论数据  - 🤖 **AI 内容分析**: 使用 LLM 分析用户痛点和市场需求 - 📄 **自动化报告生成**: 生成专业的市场验证报告

summary.zh: 该项目面向商机验证场景，围绕小红书笔记与评论抓取、LLM内容分析和自动报告生成，帮助团队识别真实用户痛点、市场需求与竞争格局。其亮点在于以用户输入创意为检索起点，串联数据采集、评论标签分析、综合评分与阶段检查点，形成可复用的市场洞察流程。
summary.en: This repository is built for business idea validation using Xiaohongshu as a real-world demand signal source. It automates note and comment collection, applies LLM-based analysis to uncover user pain points, market needs, and competitive patterns, and produces structured validation reports. The main technical strength is its end-to-end agent workflow: user-input-driven search, staged scraping and analysis, comment tag mining, combined market scoring, and checkpointed execution that makes the pipeline repeatable for opportunity discovery and product research.

metadata.name: XHS_RS_TOOLS
metadata.description: xhs_toolkit for rust

summary.zh: 该项目是面向小红书 Web 场景的 Rust 与 Python 混合工具集，结合二维码登录、访客 Cookie 获取与实时签名服务，实现低频浏览器参与、高频 Rust API 调用的自动化采集。其亮点在于纯算法签名、Cookie 同步与 Docker 化部署，适合研究逆向接口、浏览器自动化及媒体内容抓取流程。
summary.en: XHS-RS-TOOLS is a hybrid Rust and Python toolkit for Xiaohongshu web API reverse engineering and automation. It uses containerized undetected-chromedriver to obtain visitor cookies, a Rust-only QR login flow for authenticated sessions, and a Python signing agent for real-time request signatures. This design minimizes browser usage while keeping routine data access in Rust. Key strengths include pure-algorithm signing, cookie synchronization to reduce risk-control failures, Docker-based deployment, and support for search, feed collection, notifications, note details, comments, and media extraction for videos and image posts.

metadata.name: share
metadata.description: AI股市竞技场

summary.zh: 该仓库是面向 AI 量化交易竞赛与模拟的全栈平台，支持多 Agent 策略管理、行情展示、交易日志、模型对比与提示词模板配置。后端基于 Python/FastAPI，前端配合 Node.js 生态，集成 MySQL、Redis 与跨平台一键部署脚本，适合构建股票策略评测、模型博弈和可视化运营后台。
summary.en: This repository is a full-stack AI quantitative trading simulation platform built for stock strategy competition and evaluation. It provides multi-agent management, market dashboards, trading logs, prompt template configuration, model comparison, channel management, and system operations pages. The backend uses Python with FastAPI, while the frontend runs in the Node.js ecosystem, with MySQL and Redis for persistence and caching. Cross-platform deployment scripts for macOS, Linux, and Windows make it practical for rapid setup, strategy benchmarking, and operational monitoring of AI-driven trading workflows.

metadata.name: webnovel-writer
metadata.description: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。

summary.zh: Webnovel Writer 是运行于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作系统，围绕设定管理、卷章规划、章节写作、审查与记忆沉淀构建闭环，借助 Story System、状态索引与 RAG 检索，缓解 AI 连载中的遗忘、幻觉和一致性失控问题，支持百万至两百万字级持续创作。
summary.en: Webnovel Writer is a Claude Code plugin for long-form web novel production, designed to keep large serialized stories coherent over hundreds of chapters. It connects setup, outline planning, chapter drafting, review, memory accumulation, and dashboard-based inspection into one workflow. With its Story System as the source of truth, plus state indexing and RAG retrieval, it reduces forgetting, hallucination, and continuity drift in AI-assisted writing, making million-word to two-million-word scale serialization practical.

metadata.name: ai-global
metadata.description: Unified Config Manager for AI Coding Tools

summary.zh: AI Global 是面向 AI 编程工具的统一配置管理器，可在系统级与项目级场景下将单一配置同步到 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等多种工具。它自动检测环境、扫描已安装工具、备份原始配置，并合并 AGENTS、规则、命令与技能，显著降低多工具协作下的维护成本与配置分裂问题。
summary.en: AI Global is a unified configuration manager for AI coding tools that lets developers maintain one source of truth and sync it across tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and many others. It works in both system and project modes, automatically detects context, discovers installed tools, backs up existing configurations, and merges assets such as AGENTS files, rules, commands, and skills. Its core value is reducing duplicated setup effort and preventing configuration drift in multi-tool AI development workflows.

metadata.name: interactive-prompt-iterator
metadata.description: 交互式提示词优化器 - 基于 Next.js 和 AI SDK 的提示词优化工具

summary.zh: 该项目是面向提示工程的交互式优化工具，利用多轮对话把模糊需求逐步收敛为结构化、高质量 AI 提示词。基于 Next.js 与 AI SDK 构建，结合可视化表单、模板复用及 PDF/图像解析能力，适用于内容生成、智能助手配置、复杂任务拆解等场景，降低提示编写门槛并提升复用效率。
summary.en: Interactive Prompt Iterator is a prompt-engineering tool that turns vague ideas into structured, reusable AI prompts through guided multi-turn dialogue. Built with Next.js and the AI SDK, it combines visual forms, template reuse, and PDF/image parsing to streamline prompt creation. It is well suited for content generation, AI assistant setup, and complex task specification, helping users reduce prompt-design friction while improving consistency and iteration efficiency.

metadata.name: eastmoney
metadata.description: VibeAlpha Terminal 是一个专注于中国 A 股市场的智能金融分析平台，集成了基金分析、股票监控、商品追踪和市场情绪分析等功能。通过 AI 大语言模型自动生成专业的盘前/盘后分析报告，帮助投资者做出更明智的决策。

summary.zh: VAlpha Terminal 面向中国A股投资场景，整合基金、股票、商品与市场情绪分析，支持投资组合管理、资讯聚合和自动化预警。平台以 FastAPI + React 为基础，结合 AkShare/TuShare 与多模型 LLM，生成盘前盘后报告和智能投研建议，适合构建个人化金融情报终端。
summary.en: VAlpha Terminal is an AI-powered financial intelligence platform focused on China’s A-share market. It combines portfolio management, fund and stock tracking, commodity monitoring, news aggregation, sentiment analysis, and automated alerts in one workflow. Built with FastAPI, React, and TypeScript, it integrates AkShare and TuShare market data with multiple LLM providers to generate pre-market and post-market reports, AI-driven research insights, and automated investment decision support for active investors and analysts.

metadata.name: PromptX
metadata.description: PromptX 不仅仅是一个提示词存储工具，它是专为 AI 时代打造的生产力神器。采用 UI/UX Pro Max 设计标准，结合强大的 版本管理 和 智能分类，让你的 AI 工作流效率提升 10x。

summary.zh: PromptX 是面向 AI 工作流的提示词管理平台，集成版本追踪、智能分类、公共模板库与评论通知机制。基于 FastAPI、React 与 MongoDB 构建，支持跨端使用、权限审核、AI 润色和实时同步，适合团队沉淀、复用与运营高质量提示资产。
summary.en: PromptX is an AI-era prompt management platform built to organize, evolve, and distribute prompt assets efficiently. It combines version control, smart categorization, public prompt publishing, review workflows, ratings, and real-time notifications in one product. Built with FastAPI, React, TypeScript, and MongoDB, it supports cross-platform usage, admin moderation, AI-assisted prompt refinement, and collaborative knowledge sharing, making it well suited for teams that need reusable, governed, and scalable prompt operations.

metadata.name: ui-ux-pro-max-skill
metadata.description: An AI SKILL that provide design intelligence for building professional UI/UX multiple platforms

summary.zh: UI UX Pro Max 是面向多平台界面设计的 AI 技能，聚焦将需求快速转化为专业 UI/UX 方案。其核心亮点是基于推理规则的设计系统生成，可结合项目目标输出页面结构、交互模式与视觉风格建议，适用于网页、应用和跨框架产品设计提效。
summary.en: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill for professional multi-platform UI/UX design, focused on turning product requirements into production-ready design guidance. Its key strength is an AI-driven design system generator built on structured reasoning rules, producing recommended layouts, interaction patterns, and visual styles for websites, apps, and cross-framework products to speed up design decisions and consistency.

metadata.name: all-api-hub
metadata.description: All-in-one New-API/Sub2API account hub: balance/usage dashboard, auto check-in, one-click keys, price comparison, health checks, plus advanced channel management | 一站式 New-API/Sub2API 等中转站账号管理：余额/用量看板、自动签到、密钥一键使用、价格对比、可用性测试，另提供高级渠道管理

summary.zh: All API Hub 是面向 New-API/Sub2API 中转站的浏览器管理中枢，集中处理多账号余额、用量、价格与健康状态，支持自动签到、接口验证、密钥一键导出及渠道同步。其亮点在于统一看板、跨工具集成、本地优先存储与加密同步，适合高频使用多站点 AI 接口的个人与运维场景。
summary.en: All API Hub is a browser-based management hub for New-API/Sub2API relay accounts. It centralizes balance, usage, pricing, and health monitoring across multiple sites, while also supporting auto check-in, API validation, one-click key export, and channel synchronization. Its main strengths are a unified dashboard, broad tool integrations, local-first credential storage, and encrypted sync. It is well suited for users and operators who frequently manage multiple AI API relay accounts and need cost visibility, reliability checks, and streamlined key workflows.

metadata.name: OpenSpec
metadata.description: Spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding assistants.

summary.zh: 面向 AI 编码助手的规格驱动开发框架，通过提案、设计、任务与归档的结构化工件，配合 CLI 和斜杠命令，把需求拆解、实现与验证流程标准化，适合从个人项目到企业级 brownfield 改造。
summary.en: OpenSpec is a spec-driven development framework for AI coding assistants. It turns ideas into structured artifacts such as proposals, specs, designs, and tasks, then drives implementation and verification through CLI and slash-command workflows. Built for iterative work across greenfield and brownfield projects.

metadata.name: axonhub
metadata.description: ⚡️ Open-source AI Gateway — Use any SDK to call 100+ LLMs. Built-in failover, load balancing, cost control & end-to-end tracing.

summary.zh: AxonHub 是面向多模型接入的开源 AI 网关与开发平台，兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic 等主流 SDK，实现零代码切换 100+ LLM。其核心能力包括协议转换、智能负载均衡、毫秒级故障切换、成本追踪、端到端链路观测与权限控制，适合企业统一管理多厂商模型调用。
summary.en: AxonHub is an open-source AI gateway and development platform for unified multi-model access. It lets teams use existing SDKs such as OpenAI or Anthropic to call 100+ LLMs without code changes, reducing vendor lock-in and integration overhead. Key capabilities include protocol translation across providers, sub-100ms failover, smart load balancing, real-time cost tracking, end-to-end tracing, and RBAC. It is well suited for enterprises building centralized, observable, and cost-controlled AI infrastructure across multiple model vendors.

metadata.name: Prisma
metadata.description: 基于 Gemini 的可视化多智能体深度推理引擎 | A visual multi-agent deep reasoning engine powered by Gemini, featuring dynamic planning, chain-of-thought visualization, and multi-session management. Built with React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6.

summary.zh: Prisma 是面向 Gemini 与 OpenAI 兼容模型的可视化多智能体深度推理引擎，通过 Manager-Experts-Synthesis 流程将复杂问题拆解、并行执行与递归复审。项目突出思维链路可视化、分阶段思考预算、多会话本地存储与模型网关配置，适用于复杂问答、研究分析、方案推演等高认知密度场景。
summary.en: Prisma is a visual multi-agent deep reasoning engine for Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. It breaks complex prompts into coordinated stages through a Manager, parallel Experts, and final Synthesis, with recursive review to improve answer quality. Its main strengths are transparent reasoning visualization, stage-level thinking budget controls, multi-session local persistence, and flexible model gateway configuration. It is well suited for complex Q&A, research analysis, structured problem solving, and scenario planning where users need both strong reasoning depth and visibility into the process.

metadata.name: vue-fabric-editor
metadata.description: 快图设计-基于fabric.js和Vue的开源图片编辑器，可自定义字体、素材、设计模板。fabric.js and Vue based image editor, can customize fonts, materials, design templates.

summary.zh: vue-fabric-editor 是基于 Vue 与 fabric.js 的开源图片编辑器，采用插件化架构，支持拖拽设计、模板素材与字体定制。项目覆盖 PSD/JSON 导入、PNG/SVG 导出、图层、裁剪、滤镜、二维码等能力，适合在线海报设计、商品 DIY 与轻量可视化编辑场景。
summary.en: vue-fabric-editor is an open-source image editor built with Vue and fabric.js, designed around a plugin-based architecture for extensibility. It supports drag-and-drop design, customizable fonts, materials, and templates, along with practical editing features such as PSD/JSON import, PNG/SVG export, layers, cropping, filters, gradients, guides, and QR/barcode generation. The project is well suited for online poster creation, product customization, lightweight design tools, and other browser-based visual editing scenarios.

metadata.name: prompt-optimizer
metadata.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.

summary.zh: Prompt Optimizer 是面向大模型交互的提示词优化平台，支持网页、桌面、Chrome 扩展与 Docker 部署。它覆盖提示词编写、模板复用、测试评估与资产沉淀，适用于内容创作、评审对话、图像生成等场景，亮点在于多端可用、可复用变量模板与完整优化工作流。
summary.en: Prompt Optimizer is a prompt engineering platform designed to improve LLM interactions across writing, review, and text-to-image workflows. It supports web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker-based usage, making it flexible for both individuals and teams. Beyond simple prompt rewriting, it enables prompt authoring, template reuse, variable-driven generation, testing, evaluation, and long-term prompt asset management. Its main strengths are cross-platform delivery, reusable prompt workflows, and an integrated optimization loop that helps users get more consistent, controllable AI outputs.

metadata.name: ccg-workflow
metadata.description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行

summary.zh: CCG 是面向 Claude Code 的多模型协作工作流引擎，通过 `/ccg:go` 将自然语言需求自动转成策略选择、任务持久化、并行 Agent 执行与质量校验流程。它结合 Hook 注入、领域知识增强、阶段审批和 Codex 主导编排，适合复杂开发、重构、安全审查等场景，显著提升多模型协同编码的稳定性、可控性与交付效率。
summary.en: CCG is a multi-model workflow engine for Claude Code that turns a plain-language `/ccg:go` request into strategy selection, persistent task tracking, parallel agent execution, and built-in quality checks. It orchestrates Codex, Gemini, and Claude through hook-based context injection, domain-aware knowledge loading, approval gates, and Codex-led execution. The project is well suited for complex software delivery, refactoring, and security-sensitive engineering tasks where controllability, structured collaboration, and execution reliability matter.

metadata.name: CLIProxyAPI
metadata.description: Wrap Antigravity, ChatGPT Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.5, Grok 4.3, Claude model through API

summary.zh: CLIProxyAPI 将 Gemini CLI、Codex、Claude Code、Grok 等命令行能力封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini、Claude、Codex 的统一 API 服务，支持本地或多账号接入与 OAuth 登录。其价值在于复用现有 SDK 与客户端，低成本接入多模型能力，适用于 AI 开发集成、代理转发与自动化调用场景。
summary.en: CLIProxyAPI turns Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Grok and similar command-line model access into a unified API service compatible with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Codex and Grok clients. It supports local and multi-account routing, plus OAuth-based access for Codex and Claude Code. The core value is letting developers reuse existing SDKs, tools and API workflows to access multiple frontier models at lower cost, making it practical for AI integration, proxy relays, automation pipelines and multi-provider model orchestration.

metadata.name: myclaude
metadata.description: Multi-agent orchestration workflow (Claude Code  Codex Gemini OpenCode)

summary.zh: myclaude 是面向 AI 编程协作的多智能体编排工作流，统一接入 Claude、Codex、Gemini 与 OpenCode。它提供需求拆解、功能开发、调试测试和评审等模块化命令，适用于自动化研发、原型验证与团队工程提效，亮点在于智能路由、分阶段流程和可独立安装更新的技能体系。
summary.en: myclaude is a multi-agent orchestration workflow for AI-assisted software development, unifying Claude, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode behind modular commands. It covers requirement generation, feature delivery, debugging, testing, review, and browser-driven automation, making it suitable for development automation, rapid prototyping, and team productivity. Its key strengths are intelligent backend routing, structured phase-based workflows, and an installable skill/module system that supports flexible composition and updates.

metadata.name: Claude-Code-Deep-Research-main
metadata.description: 利用claude code agent框架一步一步实现deep research！很强大很简单的skills。我一步一步介绍实现deep research，因为deep research就是agent框架第一应用，对比一下各个框架实现这个deep research，就知道哪个框架才是真厉害。

summary.zh: 该仓库基于 Claude Code 的 Skills 与 Commands 构建多智能体 Deep Research 框架，面向复杂主题调研、报告生成与引用核验。其核心亮点是 Graph of Thoughts 推理、七阶段研究流程、并行角色分工及 A-E 级信源验证，兼顾易用命令式交互与结构化研究产出。
summary.en: This repository delivers a multi-agent deep research framework on top of Claude Code's Skills and Commands system. It is designed for complex topic investigation, structured report generation, and citation-backed analysis. Key strengths include a Graph of Thoughts reasoning model, a seven-phase research workflow, parallel specialized agents, and an A-E source quality validation mechanism. The project emphasizes practical usability through simple slash commands while producing organized research artifacts, making it a strong example of agentic research automation.

summary.zh: 该仓库面向 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 智能体，提供 20 余个可按需安装的技能插件，覆盖内容生成、图像卡片制作、AI 后端接入与效率工具。其亮点是以插件市场和 ClawHub 双分发模式组织技能，支持独立发布、按需安装和自动更新，减少上下文负担，适合提升日常写作、发布与工作流自动化效率。
summary.en: This repository provides 20+ installable skills for AI agents such as Claude Code and Codex, focused on improving everyday productivity. It covers content creation, image-card generation, AI backend integration, and utility workflows, while emphasizing selective installation to reduce agent context overhead. A key strength is its dual distribution model: it works both as an agent plugin marketplace and as individually publishable ClawHub skills, enabling modular adoption, independent updates, and practical workflow automation for writing, publishing, and task execution.

metadata.name: agent-designer
metadata.description: Portable SKILLs workspace for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini — issue-driven workflows and cross-agent collaboration via bridge scripts with session continuity.

summary.zh: Agent Designer 是面向 Codex、Claude Code 与 Gemini 的可移植 AI 智能体技能工作区，围绕问题驱动开发与跨代理协作设计。它用分层 SKILL 结构、桥接脚本和会话连续性机制，帮助团队把规划、评审、实现和状态跟踪沉淀为可复用流程，适合多代理协同编码、任务分派与工程规范落地。
summary.en: Agent Designer is a portable skills workspace for AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini. It focuses on issue-driven development and cross-agent collaboration, using structured SKILL definitions, bridge scripts, and session continuity to make planning, review, implementation, and status tracking reusable. The repository is especially valuable for teams that want agents to follow explicit workflows, delegate tasks safely across tools, and standardize multi-turn engineering collaboration instead of relying on ad hoc prompting.

metadata.name: KVideo
metadata.description: 一个基于 Next.js 16 构建的现代化视频聚合播放平台。采用独特的 "Liquid Glass" 设计语言，提供流畅的视觉体验和强大的视频搜索功能。

summary.zh: KVideo 是基于 Next.js 16 的视频聚合播放平台，面向多源搜索、在线点播与 IPTV 场景。项目以 Liquid Glass 视觉体系提升交互质感，结合 SSE 并行搜索、HLS 播放、代理切换、自动切源与多端播放器优化，兼顾性能、扩展性与实际部署灵活度。
summary.en: KVideo is a modern video aggregation and playback platform built with Next.js 16 for multi-source search, on-demand streaming, and IPTV use cases. It stands out with its Liquid Glass design language and a feature set focused on real-world usability: SSE-based parallel search, HLS playback, proxy-aware streaming strategies, automatic source failover, and mobile-friendly player interactions. Combined with React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and flexible source management, it balances visual polish, performance, and deployment extensibility.

metadata.name: AutoGLM-GUI
metadata.description: AutoGLM 的现代化 Web 图形界面 - 让 AI 自动化操作 Android 设备变得简单 已进化为你的专属自动化生产力工具

summary.zh: AutoGLM-GUI 是面向 Android 设备的 AI 自动化图形工具，将大模型决策、视觉理解与 ADB 控制结合，支持聊天式操作、多设备并发、工作流与定时任务。其亮点在于分层代理架构、scrcpy 实时预览、Docker 远程部署和 MCP 集成，适合构建 7x24 运行的移动端自动化助手与生产力中枢。
summary.en: AutoGLM-GUI is an AI-powered web and desktop interface for Android automation, combining LLM-based planning, visual understanding, and ADB control into a usable productivity hub. It supports conversational task execution, multi-device management, workflows, scheduling, and remote Docker deployment. Key strengths include its layered agent architecture, real-time scrcpy screen preview, MCP integration, and always-on operation for building 24/7 mobile automation assistants.

metadata.name: AntigravityQuotaWatcher
metadata.description: Google Antigravity AI模型配额监控插件 (Antigravity AI Model Quota Watching)

summary.zh: Antigravity Quota Watcher 是面向 Antigravity IDE 的配额监控插件，可自动检测本地服务端口与登录凭证，实时轮询 AI 模型剩余额度，并在状态栏与 Dashboard 中展示配额、重置时间和连接状态。其亮点是免手动配置、低配额预警、周限检测及跨平台支持，适合高频使用 Claude、GPT、Gemini 的开发者持续掌握调用成本与可用性。
summary.en: Antigravity Quota Watcher is a quota monitoring extension for Antigravity IDE that automatically detects local service ports and authentication, polls AI model usage in real time, and surfaces remaining quota through the status bar and a dashboard. Its main strengths are zero-manual setup, low-quota alerts, weekly limit checks, credential sync from local login state, and cross-platform support. It is well suited for developers who frequently use Claude, GPT, and Gemini models and need clear visibility into quota availability, reset timing, and usage continuity.

metadata.name: Open-AutoGLM
metadata.description: An Open Phone Agent Model & Framework. Unlocking the AI Phone for Everyone

summary.zh: Open-AutoGLM 是面向 Android 与鸿蒙设备的开源手机智能体框架，结合多模态屏幕理解、任务规划与 ADB/HDC 控制，实现用自然语言自动完成搜寻、输入、导航等操作，支持远程调试、人工接管与敏感确认，适合移动端 AI 助手、测试自动化和交互研究。
summary.en: Open-AutoGLM is an open-source phone agent framework for Android and HarmonyOS devices. It combines multimodal screen understanding, agent planning, and ADB/HDC-based device control to turn natural-language commands into end-to-end mobile actions such as search, navigation, and text input. The project also includes remote debugging support, human takeover for login or verification steps, and confirmation for sensitive actions. It is well suited for building AI mobile assistants, UI automation workflows, and research on real-world agent interaction on phones.

metadata.name: dompdf.js
metadata.description: Convert HTML to a multi-thousand-page vector PDF with a single line of frontend code

summary.zh: dompdf.js 是一个前端浏览器内 HTML 转矢量 PDF 工具，基于 DOM 解析而非截图，可直接生成可编辑、可打印、体积更小的多页 PDF，支持分页、文本、图片、背景、Canvas 与 SVG，尤其适合报表、长文档与超大页数导出场景。
summary.en: dompdf.js is a browser-side HTML-to-vector-PDF library that converts DOM content into editable, printable PDF files without server-side rendering or image-based screenshots. Built on modified html2canvas rendering logic and jsPDF output, it supports pagination, text, images, backgrounds, Canvas, and SVG. Its main strength is generating smaller, high-quality PDFs that can span thousands of pages, making it well suited for reports, long-form documents, and large-scale frontend export scenarios where vector output matters more than pixel-perfect visual fidelity.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: This repository contains a collection of Agent Skills developed by GudaStudio, enabling seamless collaboration between Claude and other AI models and tools.

summary.zh: 该仓库汇集 GudaStudio 开发的 Claude Agent Skills，通过模块化安装机制把 Codex、Gemini 等模型与外部工具接入 Claude Code，适合代码原型、调试与评审协作。项目提供跨平台一键安装、用户级与项目级部署及按需启用能力，突出多模型协同、工作流复用与低门槛集成。
summary.en: This repository packages GudaStudio's Agent Skills for Claude Code, extending Claude with modular integrations for external AI models and tools such as Codex CLI and Gemini CLI. It targets coding workflows including prototyping, debugging, and code review, where multi-model collaboration improves execution flexibility. The main technical strengths are on-demand skill loading, cross-platform installation scripts for Windows and Unix-like systems, and support for both user-level and project-level deployment, making it practical for reusable agent workflows and low-friction integration into developer environments.

metadata.name: DesktopFriends
metadata.description: A desktop companion for Live2D driven by agent system.

summary.zh: DesktopFriends 是一款基于 Live2D 的跨平台 AI 桌宠，面向桌面陪伴、对话交互与轻量任务管理场景。项目以 Vue、TypeScript、Tauri/Capacitor 为基础，结合自研 ReAct 智能体、多模型接入、工具调用、局域网联动和日程心跳机制，实现会说话、可调度、可控件操作的数字伙伴。
summary.en: DesktopFriends is a cross-platform AI desktop companion built around Live2D for conversational companionship, lightweight task assistance, and ambient desktop interaction. It combines Vue, TypeScript, Tauri, and Capacitor with a custom ReAct-style agent engine, multi-LLM support, streaming chat, tool calling, LAN-based multi-device connectivity, and a local heartbeat scheduling system. The result is a controllable digital pet that can express emotions, manage widgets, trigger timely actions, and extend AI presence from desktop to repurposed mobile devices.

metadata.name: code-switch-R
metadata.description: Claude Code & Codex 多供应商代理与管理工具

summary.zh: Code Switch 是面向 Claude Code、Codex 与 Gemini CLI 的桌面代理管理工具，提供多供应商接入、优先级故障切换、模型映射、Token 与成本统计，并统一管理 MCP 与 CLI 配置。基于 Wails、Go、Vue 构建，适合多密钥、多通道和稳定性要求高的 AI 编程工作流。
summary.en: Code Switch is a desktop proxy and management tool for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It routes requests through configurable providers, supports priority-based failover, model name mapping, token and cost tracking, and centralized MCP and CLI configuration management. Built with Wails, Go, Vue, and SQLite, it is designed for AI coding workflows that need multi-provider switching, operational visibility, and higher reliability across multiple API keys and service endpoints.

metadata.name: EnsoAI
metadata.description: Multiple Agents, Parallel Flow

summary.zh: EnsoAI 是面向代码项目的多智能体桌面协作工具，利用 Git worktree 为 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等代理提供并行且独立的上下文工作区。它将终端代理调度、可视化 Git 管理与跨平台桌面体验整合在一起，适合多分支开发、并行实验、代码审查与自动化协作场景，显著减少上下文切换和分支操作成本。
summary.en: EnsoAI is a cross-platform desktop workspace for parallel AI-assisted software development. It uses Git worktrees to give Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other CLI agents isolated, persistent contexts within the same project, enabling simultaneous branch-based workflows without constant context switching. By combining multi-agent orchestration, terminal-centric interaction, and visual Git controls in an Electron app, it is well suited for multi-branch coding, experimentation, review, and automation-heavy engineering workflows.

metadata.name: gemini-3-pro-image-preview
metadata.description: Gemini 3 Pro - AI 绘图工作台 (Web Client)

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Gemini 3 Pro 与兼容 OpenAI 接口的 AI 绘图 Web 工作台，聚焦高分辨率生成、批量并发创作与连续对话。项目以原生 JavaScript 实现，集成 IndexedDB、本地自动保存、提示词管理和图片切片等工具，适合内容创作、参考图生成和多渠道图像生产场景。
summary.en: Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview is a web-based AI image studio built for Gemini 3 Pro and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It focuses on high-resolution generation, concurrent batch creation, and context-aware conversational workflows. Implemented in vanilla JavaScript, it combines IndexedDB session persistence, local auto-save via File System Access API, prompt management, and image slicing tools, making it well suited for creative production, reference-image workflows, and multi-endpoint visual content generation.

metadata.name: claude-code-hub
metadata.description: 一个现代化的 Claude Code & Codex API 代理服务，提供智能负载均衡、用户管理和使用统计功能。

summary.zh: Claude Code Hub 是面向团队的 AI API 代理与运营平台，统一接入 Claude、OpenAI 等模型，提供智能负载均衡、用户管理、用量统计、价格控制与实时监控。基于 Next.js 15、Hono、PostgreSQL、Redis 构建，适合多供应商接入、稳定调度与可观测化运维场景。
summary.en: Claude Code Hub is a team-oriented AI API proxy and operations platform that unifies access to Claude, OpenAI-compatible, and other model providers. It delivers intelligent load balancing, user management, usage analytics, pricing control, real-time monitoring, and automated documentation. Built with Next.js 15, Hono, PostgreSQL, and Redis, it is well suited for organizations that need multi-vendor model access, resilient traffic scheduling, secure gateway management, and observable AI service operations.

metadata.name: redBookMCP
metadata.description: 小红书MCP Server一站式图文内容生成

summary.zh: 这是一个面向小红书图文创作的 MCP Server，围绕大模型完成选题大纲生成、图片生成、内容编辑与项目管理，适合在 Claude Desktop 中串联内容生产流程。技术亮点是基于 MCP 协议接入、支持外部图像模型配置，并以项目化资源管理提升多页图文生成效率。项目现已停止演进，主要作为实现范式参考。
summary.en: This repository provides an MCP server for Xiaohongshu-style post creation, covering outline generation, image generation, outline editing, and project management in a single workflow. It is designed to integrate with Claude Desktop through the Model Context Protocol, allowing users to orchestrate multi-page image-and-text content production with external image model configuration. Its main technical value lies in MCP-based tool exposure and project-oriented resource management. The project is now deprecated, so its strongest value is as a reference implementation for AI-assisted content generation workflows.

metadata.name: AI-generated-English-podcast-videos
metadata.description: 一键生成英文教育短视频 - 自动生成双人流畅对话、语音讲解、教育单词图片。AI生成英语对话的播客视频！一键生成，下载视频，学英语，发抖音。 AI-generated English conversation podcast videos! Create with one click, download videos, learn English, and share on TikTok.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向英语学习与短视频分发的 AI 视频生成工具，输入文章即可自动产出英语对话文案、配音、字幕、背景音乐与无版权素材，并合成为高清播客视频。项目提供 WebUI 与 API，采用 MVC 架构，支持多模型接入、批量生成、多尺寸输出及字幕样式配置，适合内容创作、口语训练和 TikTok/抖音发布。
summary.en: This repository is an AI-powered short-video generator for English learning and social content production. Given an article, it automatically creates conversation scripts, voiceovers, subtitles, background music, royalty-free footage, and merges them into HD podcast-style videos. It offers both a Web UI and API with a maintainable MVC architecture, supports multiple LLM providers, batch generation, flexible aspect ratios, and subtitle styling, making it practical for creators, educators, and TikTok-style publishing workflows.

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 React 19、Vite 6 与 TypeScript 的 Gemini 3 Pro 纯前端客户端，支持文本与多图多模态对话、拖拽上传、图片历史与下载、思维链可视化及等待街机模式。项目强调零后端部署、流式交互、响应式体验与本地配置持久化，适合快速构建轻量 AI 图文创作与交互应用。
summary.en: UndyDraw is a frontend-only Gemini 3 Pro client built with React 19, Vite 6, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It supports multimodal chat with text and multi-image input, drag-and-drop uploads, image history and downloads, chain-of-thought visualization, and arcade mini-games during long model responses. With no backend required, local API key persistence, responsive design, streaming output, and configurable model and endpoint settings, it is well suited for lightweight AI chat, image generation, and interactive creative tooling in the browser.

metadata.name: tgbot-verify
metadata.description: 一个基于 Python Telegram Bot 的自动化认证工具，能够自动完成 SheerID 平台的学生/教师身份验证流程。

summary.zh: 该仓库是面向 SheerID 学生与教师认证场景的 Telegram 自动化机器人，基于 Python、Playwright 与 MySQL，实现身份信息生成、证件图片制作、认证提交及积分管理，适合部署为多平台认证代办与运营工具。
summary.en: This repository provides a Telegram bot for automating SheerID-based student and teacher verification across multiple services. Built with Python, python-telegram-bot, Playwright, and MySQL, it handles identity data generation, document image creation, verification submission, and credit-based user management. Its main value is turning a repetitive manual workflow into an operational bot service that supports concurrency control, admin commands, and containerized deployment, making it practical for verification automation and lightweight service operations.

metadata.name: banana-slides
metadata.description: 一个基于nano banana pro🍌的原生AI PPT生成应用，迈向＂Vibe PPT＂; 支持上传任意模板图片，上传任意素材&智能解析，一句话/大纲/页面描述自动生成PPT，口头修改指定区域、一键导出可编辑ppt - An AI-native slides generator based on nano banana pro🍌

summary.zh: Banana Slides 是一款原生 AI PPT 生成应用，基于 nano banana pro 与多模型能力，将模板图、参考素材和一句话/大纲输入转成高质量演示文稿。它强调风格可控、区域级口头修改、素材智能解析与可编辑 PPT 导出，适合教育、汇报和内容创作等高频场景。
summary.en: Banana Slides is an AI-native presentation generator built around nano banana pro and multi-model workflows. It turns template images, reference assets, and simple prompts, outlines, or page descriptions into polished slides in minutes. The project stands out for style control, intelligent asset parsing, region-level natural-language editing, and one-click export to editable PPT files, making it practical for education, business reporting, and fast content production where both speed and visual quality matter.

metadata.name: AMC-WebUI
metadata.description: 面向 Gemini 的 Local-First AI 工作流 WebUI，集成多模态聊天、Canvas、文件处理、实时搜索、代码执行与高级推理。

summary.zh: AMC WebUI 是面向 Gemini 的 Local-First AI 工作流控制台，集成多模态对话、Canvas、文件解析、实时搜索、代码执行与深度推理。基于 React 与 TypeScript 构建，兼容 OpenAI 标准聊天接口，支持浏览器本地存储、独立 API 部署及实时音视频交互，适合构建高隐私、高交互的 AI 生产力工作台。
summary.en: AMC WebUI is a local-first AI workflow console centered on Gemini-native capabilities, combining multimodal chat, canvas interaction, file processing, real-time search, code execution, and advanced reasoning in one web interface. Built with React and TypeScript, it also supports OpenAI-compatible chat APIs, browser-side data storage, standalone API deployment, and live audio/video interaction. It fits privacy-conscious, highly interactive AI productivity scenarios for individuals, developers, and lightweight team workflows.

metadata.name: ccstatusline
metadata.description: 🚀 Beautiful highly customizable statusline for Claude Code CLI with powerline support, themes, and more.

summary.zh: ccstatusline 是面向 Claude Code CLI 的终端状态栏美化与信息聚合工具，基于 Node.js 提供主题、Powerline 样式和多组件扩展能力，可展示模型、Git 分支、Token 与用量指标。其亮点在于高度可定制、跨平台支持、版本锁定安装及 Git 缓存优化，适合提升 AI 编码终端的可观测性与交互体验。
summary.en: ccstatusline is a customizable status line formatter for the Claude Code CLI, built with Node.js to improve terminal visibility during AI-assisted development. It surfaces practical context such as model details, Git branch state, token consumption, and usage metrics through themes, Powerline-style rendering, and modular widgets. Key strengths include deep customization, cross-platform support, pinned-version installation, and Git cache optimizations that reduce background command overhead, making it useful for developers who want a more informative and polished CLI workflow.

metadata.name: geminimcp
metadata.description: Gemini-MCP is an MCP server that encapsulates Google's Gemini CLI tool into a standard MCP protocol interface, enabling Claude Code to invoke Gemini for AI-assisted programming tasks.

summary.zh: Gemini-MCP 将 Google Gemini CLI 封装为标准 MCP 服务，使 Claude Code 可直接调用 Gemini 协同完成编程任务。项目聚焦 AI 辅助开发，尤其强化前端设计与代码生成场景，借助 MCP 协议、Python 3.12+ 与 uv 安装链路，实现低门槛接入、标准化集成和多模型协作。
summary.en: Gemini-MCP wraps Google’s Gemini CLI as a standard MCP server, allowing Claude Code to invoke Gemini for collaborative AI programming workflows. It targets AI-assisted development, with a notable strength in frontend design and code generation scenarios. Built on Python 3.12+ and aligned with the Model Context Protocol, it offers straightforward installation via uv and a practical bridge for standardized multi-model coding integration.

metadata.name: claude-relay-service
metadata.description: CRS-自建Claude Code镜像，一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Droid 订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。

summary.zh: Claude Relay Service 是面向 Claude Code 自建接入的开源中转平台，统一接入 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 与 Droid 订阅，支持多账号轮换、拼车共享、独立 API Key、用量统计与管理面板。项目基于 Node.js、Redis 和 Docker，强调低门槛部署、隐私可控、成本分摊与原生工具兼容，适合受地域限制或有稳定接入需求的团队自托管使用。
summary.en: Claude Relay Service is an open source self-hosted relay platform for Claude Code and related AI subscriptions. It unifies access to Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and Droid through one service, with multi-account rotation, shared subscription management, per-user API keys, usage tracking, and a web admin panel. Built with Node.js, Redis, and Docker, it focuses on privacy control, cost sharing, operational stability, and compatibility with native tools, making it suitable for teams needing reliable, self-managed access under regional or policy constraints.

metadata.name: code-switch
metadata.description: Claude Code & Codex 多供应商代理与管理工具

summary.zh: Code Switch 是面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的多供应商代理管理桌面工具，借助本地 HTTP 代理实现无重启切换、自动故障回退与请求级用量统计。基于 Wails 3 构建，兼顾跨平台 GUI、MCP Server 管理及 Skill 仓库安装，适合需要稳定接入多模型服务、统一配置与成本可视化的开发者团队。
summary.en: Code Switch is a desktop management tool for Claude Code and Codex that centralizes multi-provider routing through a local HTTP proxy. It enables seamless provider switching without restarting clients, automatic failover across vendors, and request-level usage tracking for clear cost visibility. Built with Wails 3, it also supports MCP Server management, Claude Skill repository installation, and cross-platform packaging. It is well suited for developers and teams that need reliable multi-model access, unified configuration, and transparent operational control across AI coding workflows.

metadata.name: Video-Materials-AutoGEN-Workstation
metadata.description: 一个集内容策划、AI文案自动生成、TTS 批量自动配音、(AI)图片素材合成、ASR自动提取语言字幕脚本、AI自由创作于一体的(短视频)生成工作站。方便管理每期的视频项目。

summary.zh: 该项目是面向短视频生产的 AI 工作站，围绕项目管理串联文案生成、TTS 批量配音、图片素材合成与字幕提取流程。其亮点是模板化批量生成、图文音分轨管理，以及 Gemini、TTS、ASR 与绘图能力的统一接入，适合内容团队提升素材制作与复用效率。
summary.en: This repository is an AI workstation for short-form video production, combining project management with script generation, batch TTS voiceover, image asset creation, and subtitle extraction. Its core value lies in turning fragmented creative steps into a reusable workflow with template-based project generation and track-level management of text, audio, and visuals. By integrating Gemini, TTS, ASR, and image generation into one interface, it suits creators and small content teams that need faster asset production, iteration, and organization across recurring video projects.

metadata.name: flow2api
metadata.description: 无限次数的banana pro！逆向账号池，支持负载均衡、AT自动刷新、缓存策略、代理等。Q交流群1073237297

summary.zh: Flow2API 是面向 Flow 的 OpenAI/Gemini 兼容 API 网关，聚焦图像与视频生成统一接入。项目通过多 Token 账号池、负载均衡、AT/ST 自动刷新、缓存与代理机制，提升可用性与稳定性，并提供 Web 管理台、监控指标和 Docker 部署，适合多账号运营、接口转发与自动化生产场景。
summary.en: Flow2API is an OpenAI- and Gemini-compatible API gateway built to unify access to Flow image and video generation capabilities. It supports text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video workflows, while improving reliability through multi-token pooling, load balancing, automatic AT/ST refresh, caching, and proxy support. The project also includes a web admin console, health and Prometheus metrics endpoints, and Docker-based deployment, making it suitable for API forwarding, multi-account operations, and automated media generation services.

metadata.name: bilibili-video-downloader
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库

summary.zh: 这是面向 B 站内容归档与媒体库整理的跨平台下载工具，基于 Tauri 提供轻量图形界面，支持普通视频、番剧、课程等多类型资源下载。除高画质音视频获取外，还集成字幕、弹幕、封面、NFO 刮削、章节与广告标记，便于无缝接入 Emby 等本地媒体中心，兼顾效率、组织性与可用性。
summary.en: This project is a cross-platform Bilibili downloader built for personal archiving and media-library integration. With a lightweight Tauri-based GUI, it supports downloading regular videos, premium content, anime, TV series, movies, and courses. Beyond video and audio capture, it also fetches subtitles, danmaku, covers, and metadata, while generating NFO files, chapter markers, and ad-skip markers. Its main strength is turning Bilibili content into well-structured assets that can be imported cleanly into Emby and similar media server ecosystems.

metadata.name: Mole
metadata.description: 🐹 Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac from the terminal.

summary.zh: Mole 是面向 macOS 的终端系统维护工具，将清理、卸载、磁盘分析、性能优化与实时监控整合为单一 CLI。它可深度清除缓存、日志和残留文件，智能卸载应用及隐藏依赖，并提供磁盘可视化与 CPU/内存/网络状态监控，适合开发者和重度 Mac 用户进行高效本地运维与空间治理。
summary.en: Mole is a macOS terminal-based system maintenance toolkit that unifies cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, performance optimization, and live monitoring in a single CLI. It removes caches, logs, browser leftovers, and orphaned app data, supports smart uninstall with hidden remnants cleanup, and offers disk visualization plus real-time CPU, memory, disk, GPU, and network insights. It is well suited for developers and power users managing local system health and storage efficiency.

metadata.name: RedInk
metadata.description: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."

summary.zh: RedInk 是面向小红书内容创作的一站式 AI 图文生成工具，输入一句话即可自动生成大纲、封面与多页内容图，强调风格统一与文字准确。项目采用 Flask 后端与 Vue 3 前端，结合 Gemini 3 和 Nano Banana Pro，支持并发生成、局部重绘、Web 配置及 Docker 快速部署，适合自媒体运营与批量内容生产。
summary.en: RedInk is an end-to-end AI content generator for Xiaohongshu posts, turning a single sentence into structured outlines, cover images, and multi-page visual-text content. It focuses on style consistency, accurate text rendering, and efficient batch generation for social media workflows. The project combines a Flask backend with a Vue 3 and TypeScript frontend, integrates Gemini 3 for text and Nano Banana Pro for images, and supports concurrent generation, page-level regeneration, browser-based configuration, and fast Docker deployment for creators and growth teams.

metadata.name: codexmcp
metadata.description: Enable seamless collaboration between Claude Code and Codex, transforming from a single agent to multiple agents for significantly enhanced productivity!

summary.zh: CodexMCP 是连接 Claude Code 与 Codex 的 MCP 协作桥梁，面向 AI 辅助编程与多智能体开发场景。它支持会话持久化、多轮上下文、并行任务与推理追踪，让架构规划、代码实现、调试审查分工协作，较官方方案更适合高效率、可追溯的工程化开发流程。
summary.en: CodexMCP is an MCP-based collaboration bridge between Claude Code and Codex, built for AI-assisted programming and multi-agent software workflows. It combines Claude Code's strength in planning and architecture with Codex's strength in implementation, debugging, and review. Compared with the official Codex MCP approach, it adds session persistence, multi-turn context management, parallel task execution, reasoning traceability, and stronger error handling, making it better suited for efficient, auditable, and production-oriented engineering collaboration.

metadata.name: mcp-router
metadata.description: A Unified MCP Server Management App (MCP Manager).

summary.zh: MCP Router 是面向 AI 工具链的桌面化 MCP 服务器统一管理应用，支持本地与远程服务接入、项目与工作区分组、工具级开关及日志分析。其亮点在于跨平台部署、兼容多类 MCP 配置格式，并强调数据与凭证全程本地存储，适合多客户端、多上下文的 MCP 运维管理。
summary.en: MCP Router is a cross-platform desktop app for centralized management of Model Context Protocol servers across AI toolchains. It connects to local and remote MCP servers, supports multiple configuration modes such as DXT, JSON, and manual setup, and organizes servers through projects and workspaces. It also provides tool-level toggling, request logging, and analytics from a single interface. A key strength is its privacy-first design: configurations, logs, and credentials remain stored locally, making it well suited for secure multi-client MCP operations and context management.

metadata.name: Claude-Code-Workflow
metadata.description: JSON-driven multi-agent  cadence-team development framework with   intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex),   context-first architecture, and automated workflow   execution

summary.zh: 这是一个以 JSON 驱动的多智能体开发框架，面向团队化 AI 编程与流程编排。它通过统一调度 Gemini、Codex、Qwen、Claude 等 CLI，实现技能化工作流、上下文优先协作、会话生命周期管理与后台队列执行，适用于复杂研发流程自动化、多人协同开发和智能终端编排场景。
summary.en: Claude Code Workflow is a JSON-driven multi-agent development framework built for team-based AI coding and workflow orchestration. It unifies CLI agents such as Gemini, Codex, Qwen, and Claude, and emphasizes context-first execution, skill-based workflows, session lifecycle management, and queued automation. It is well suited for complex software delivery pipelines, collaborative engineering workflows, and intelligent terminal-based orchestration.

metadata.name: harmony-cursor-rules
metadata.description: 🎯 基于AI技术自动提取华为HarmonyOS官方最佳实践，生成专业的CursorRules规则文件。解决主流AI模型缺乏HarmonyOS语料的痛点，为开发者提供准确的智能代码提示。

summary.zh: 该项目面向HarmonyOS开发场景，自动爬取华为官方最佳实践与ArkTS迁移指南，结合Gemini提炼结构化CursorRules。它弥补主流大模型HarmonyOS语料不足的问题，为开发者提供更准确的代码提示、迁移约束和界面开发规范，适合提升AI辅助编程在鸿蒙项目中的可用性与专业度。
summary.en: This repository targets HarmonyOS development by automatically crawling Huawei’s official best-practice and ArkTS migration documentation, then using Gemini to extract structured CursorRules files. Its core value is addressing the lack of HarmonyOS-specific training data in mainstream AI coding models, so developers can get more reliable code suggestions, UI development guidance, and migration constraints. It is especially useful for improving the accuracy and practical value of AI-assisted programming in HarmonyOS projects and standardizing team-level development conventions.

metadata.name: BettaFish
metadata.description: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。

summary.zh: 微舆是一个从零实现的多Agent舆情分析助手，面向品牌监测、热点追踪与决策支持场景，自动分析30多个海内外社媒及海量评论。其亮点在于纯Python轻量架构、Agent论坛式协作、复合分析引擎与多模态解析，并支持公私域数据融合与快速定制扩展。
summary.en: BettaFish is a from-scratch multi-agent public opinion analysis assistant built for brand monitoring, trend tracking, and decision support. It can analyze over 30 major domestic and global social platforms along with massive volumes of user comments through a chat-like workflow. Key strengths include a lightweight pure-Python architecture, a forum-style agent collaboration mechanism, a composite analysis engine beyond plain LLM prompting, multimodal parsing for text, video, and structured search cards, plus seamless integration of public and private data for extensible domain-specific analysis.

metadata.name: DesktopCommanderMCP
metadata.description: This is MCP server for Claude that gives it terminal control, file system search and diff file editing capabilities

summary.zh: Desktop Commander MCP 是面向 Claude 等模型的桌面自动化与开发控制服务器，结合 MCP、终端进程管理、文件搜索与差异编辑能力，支持远程 AI 操作、本地代码执行、文档与表格处理，适合 AI 编程协作、运维执行和跨文件内容管理场景。
summary.en: Desktop Commander MCP is an MCP server that gives Claude and other AI clients controlled access to terminal commands, process management, filesystem search, and diff-based file editing. It extends AI coding workflows with remote desktop control, in-memory code execution, live file interaction, and support for PDFs, DOCX, and Excel files. The project is well suited for AI-assisted development, automation, operations tasks, and document-centered workflows that require practical, local tool access without relying only on hosted API tooling.

metadata.name: MuMuAINovel
metadata.description: 一款基于 AI 的智能小说创作助手，帮助你轻松创作精彩故事

summary.zh: MuMuAINovel 是面向网文与长篇故事创作的 AI 写作助手，集成多模型调用、剧情大纲生成、角色关系管理、章节重写润色与伏笔追踪能力。项目采用 FastAPI + React + PostgreSQL 架构，支持 Docker 部署、多用户隔离及 Prompt 可视化配置，适合个人作者和小团队高效协同创作。
summary.en: MuMuAINovel is an AI-powered writing assistant built for web fiction and long-form storytelling. It supports multiple LLM providers such as OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude, and combines outline generation, character and worldbuilding management, chapter drafting, rewriting, polishing, and foreshadow tracking in one workflow. Built with FastAPI, React, and PostgreSQL, it offers Docker-based deployment, multi-user data isolation, and visual prompt configuration, making it suitable for individual authors and small teams seeking a structured, production-ready creative writing platform.

metadata.name: video-to-txt
metadata.description: 二开项目，多模态 AI 视频分析、本地/云端双引擎 (支持 Ollama 与 OpenAI 兼容 API)、智能关键帧提取与画质分析、高性能音频转录 (Whisper)、AI 摘要报告与动态媒体生成 (视频/GIF)、集成化 WebUI 与实时流式响应、自动化环境配置与系统资源监控

summary.zh: 该项目是面向视频理解与内容提炼的多模态 AI 分析工具，结合本地 Ollama 与 OpenAI 兼容云端模型，完成关键帧提取、Whisper 音频转录、画质评估、摘要报告及 GIF/视频生成。其价值在于把长视频快速转为可检索、可复用的结构化信息，适用于学习研究、媒体剪辑、内容分析与事实核查，并通过 Gradio WebUI、实时流式响应和自动化环境配置降低部署门槛。
summary.en: This repository is a multimodal AI video analysis tool designed to turn long-form video into structured, reusable insights. It combines local Ollama models with OpenAI-compatible cloud APIs for visual understanding, keyframe extraction, Faster-Whisper transcription, quality analysis, and automatic summary media generation such as highlight videos and GIFs. The project is especially useful for research, content production, media review, and fact checking. Its main strengths are the integrated Gradio WebUI, real-time streaming responses, local-first privacy, flexible deployment, and automated setup with resource monitoring.

metadata.name: cc-switch
metadata.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io

summary.zh: CC Switch 是面向 AI 编码助手生态的跨平台桌面管理器，统一接入 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等工具，集中处理切换、配置与协同使用。项目基于 Tauri 2 构建，兼顾轻量性能、多系统支持与一站式开发工作流整合。
summary.en: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop manager built for the AI coding assistant ecosystem. It brings Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent into one interface, making tool switching, configuration, and daily use more efficient. Built with Tauri 2, it targets Windows, macOS, and Linux with a lightweight footprint and native-style performance. Its core value lies in simplifying fragmented agent tooling into a unified desktop workflow for developers who rely on multiple AI assistants.

metadata.name: spec-kit
metadata.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development

summary.zh: Spec Kit 是 GitHub 开源的规范驱动开发工具包，通过 Specify CLI 将需求说明转化为可执行实现，帮助团队围绕产品场景、约束与预期结果协作开发。其亮点是集成 AI 编码代理、支持模板扩展与版本自升级，提升交付质量、一致性与启动效率。
summary.en: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit from GitHub for Spec-Driven Development, centered on the Specify CLI to turn structured specifications into executable implementation workflows. It helps teams focus on product scenarios, constraints, and predictable outcomes instead of ad hoc coding. Key strengths include integration with AI coding agents, extensible presets and templates, and built-in self-upgrade and project initialization flows. It is well suited for teams that want faster project bootstrapping, more consistent delivery, and a clearer path from requirements to working software.

metadata.name: mise
metadata.description: dev tools, env vars, task runner

summary.zh: mise 是面向开发环境治理的一体化 CLI，将工具版本管理、项目级环境变量加载与任务编排统一到 `mise.toml`。它适用于本地开发、多人协作与 CI 场景，支持按目录自动切换 Node、Python、Terraform 等工具，减少环境漂移，强调跨 Shell 一致性、无 shim 路径和高效工程化体验。
summary.en: mise is an all-in-one CLI for development environment management, unifying tool version control, project-scoped environment variables, and task orchestration in a single `mise.toml` file. It is designed for local development, team onboarding, and CI pipelines, helping keep shells, repositories, and jobs aligned. With support for automatically switching versions of tools like Node, Python, and Terraform per project, mise reduces environment drift and stands out through cross-shell consistency, real binary paths instead of shims, and a streamlined developer workflow.

metadata.name: rustdesk
metadata.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

summary.zh: RustDesk 是面向自托管场景的开源远程桌面应用，以 Rust 为核心实现，兼顾安全性、低门槛部署与跨平台体验。它支持开箱即用连接，也可自建中继与信令服务器，适合企业远程运维、技术支持和隐私敏感的远程访问需求。
summary.en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop platform built around Rust and designed for self-hosted, privacy-conscious remote access. It provides out-of-the-box connectivity while allowing teams to run their own rendezvous and relay servers for full data control. With cross-platform clients and a focus on secure, low-friction deployment, it fits enterprise remote support, IT operations, and organizations seeking an alternative to proprietary tools such as TeamViewer.

metadata.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
metadata.description: 利用AI大模型，一键生成高清短视频 Generate short videos with one click using AI LLM.

summary.zh: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一款基于 AI 大模型的短视频自动化生成工具，输入主题或关键词即可完成文案、配音、字幕、素材、配乐到成片合成。项目同时提供 Web 与 API，支持批量生成、多尺寸画幅、多模型接入及本地素材替换，适合内容营销、知识传播与短视频生产提效场景。
summary.en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an AI-powered short video generation tool that turns a topic or keywords into a complete HD video, covering script writing, voice synthesis, subtitles, stock footage, background music, and final rendering. It provides both Web UI and API interfaces, supports batch generation, multiple aspect ratios, multilingual scripts, customizable subtitles, and integration with many LLM providers. It is well suited for content marketing, educational media, and automated short-form video production workflows.

metadata.name: sf-express-return-picture
metadata.description: 顺丰电商退货地址截图模拟.Simulation of SF-Express E-commerce Return Address Screenshot.

summary.zh: 该项目基于纯前端 HTML+JavaScript，模拟顺丰及京东、中通、申通等电商退货地址截图界面，用于快速生成规范化寄件信息画面。核心价值在于降低手工拼图成本，支持剪贴板粘贴、复制与一键清空，适合本地静态部署和多平台退货场景演示。
summary.en: This project is a front-end HTML and JavaScript simulator for SF Express e-commerce return-address screenshots, with templates that also fit platforms such as JD, STO, and ZTO. Its core value is reducing the manual effort of composing standardized shipping-information screens for return workflows. The app runs as a static page, supports clipboard paste/copy and quick reset actions, and is suitable for local deployment, multi-platform mockup generation, and return-process demonstrations where a consistent screenshot-style interface is needed.

metadata.name: file-transfer-go
metadata.description: Go/React开发的端到端webrtc的文件传输/文字传输/桌面共享，安全，隐私，数据不经过服务器。

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 Go、React 与 WebRTC 的端到端 P2P 传输工具，支持文件、文本、桌面共享与目录同步。数据直连不落盘服务器，兼顾隐私与传输效率；配合 WebSocket 信令、断点续传、响应式界面和单文件部署，适合跨平台即时分享与轻量协作场景。
summary.en: File Transfer Go is an end-to-end P2P sharing tool built with Go, React, and WebRTC for file transfer, text delivery, desktop sharing, and directory sync. It keeps payload data off the server by using direct peer connections, improving privacy and transfer efficiency. With WebSocket signaling, resumable large-file delivery, responsive multi-device UX, and single-binary deployment, it fits secure ad hoc sharing, lightweight collaboration, and self-hosted cross-platform transfer scenarios.

metadata.name: tts
metadata.description: 一个基于 Microsoft Edge TTS 的免费在线语音合成服务，支持 20+ 种中文声音，一键将文字转换为自然流畅的语音。

summary.zh: 这是一个部署于 Cloudflare Workers 的 AI 语音处理平台，基于 Microsoft Edge TTS 提供高质量文本转语音，并集成硅基流动 API 实现语音转文字。项目支持多语言、丰富音色与参数调节，兼容 OpenAI TTS API，适合在线语音生成、转录和轻量化集成场景。
summary.en: VoiceCraft is an AI voice processing platform built for Cloudflare Workers, combining Microsoft Edge TTS for natural text-to-speech and SiliconFlow API for speech-to-text transcription. It supports multiple languages, 20+ Chinese voices, adjustable speaking parameters, and downloadable audio output. The project also offers an OpenAI-compatible TTS API, making it suitable for browser-based voice tools, lightweight deployment, and application integration scenarios that need both synthesis and transcription in a single service.

metadata.name: request-manager
metadata.description: request-manager

summary.zh: 该项目是面向接口测试与自动化执行的HTTP请求管理平台，采用FastAPI与React构建，支持Fiddler Raw、cURL导入，请求CRUD、定时调度、多线程并发、失败重试与代理轮换，适合接口测试、采集任务编排和批量请求运维场景。
summary.en: RequestManager is an HTTP request management and automation platform built with FastAPI and React. It supports importing requests from Fiddler Raw and cURL, managing request lifecycles with full CRUD, and automating execution through scheduled jobs, multithreaded concurrency, retry policies, and proxy rotation. With execution history, statistics, and real-time task monitoring, it fits API testing, batch request orchestration, and operational workflows that need controllable, repeatable, and observable HTTP task execution.

metadata.name: Sketch2Motion
metadata.description: convert photo or sketch to motion video

summary.zh: Sketch2Motion 是一款将照片、涂鸦或草图自动转换为绘制动画视频的轻量工具，基于图像转 SVG 向量化、Manim 渲染与 ffmpeg 拼接流程，提供 Gradio 可视化界面，可调节时长、路径延迟、缩放与动效风格，适合内容创作、教学演示与创意原型生成。
summary.en: Sketch2Motion is a lightweight tool that turns photos, doodles, and sketches into drawing-animation videos. It converts raster images into SVG vector graphics, renders animated strokes with Manim, and post-processes output with ffmpeg to create polished MP4 clips with a smooth intro pause. The Gradio web UI exposes controls for duration, subpath delay, scale, and drawing style, making it useful for creative prototyping, educational demos, visual storytelling, and simple motion-content generation without complex animation software.

metadata.name: xiaohongshu-mcp
metadata.description: MCP for xiaohongshu.com

summary.zh: xiaohongshu-mcp 是面向小红书的数据访问与运营自动化 MCP 服务，让 AI 助手可直接完成登录、搜索、推荐抓取、帖子详情读取、评论互动及图文/视频发布。项目以 Docker 与浏览器插件双形态降低部署门槛，适合内容运营、数据采集、智能体集成与自动化工作流场景。
summary.en: xiaohongshu-mcp is an MCP server for xiaohongshu.com that lets AI assistants directly access platform data and execute publishing workflows. It supports login, search, feed retrieval, post detail extraction, commenting, and image or video posting, making it useful for content operations, research, agent integration, and workflow automation. The project offers both a Docker-based deployment path and a browser-plugin alternative, reducing setup friction while keeping the integration practical for developers and non-technical users.

metadata.name: cunzhi
metadata.description: 告别AI提前终止烦恼，助力AI更加持久

summary.zh: 寸止是一款面向 MCP 客户端的跨平台 AI 对话增强工具，专门拦截助手过早结束交流的问题。它通过智能弹窗续聊、项目级记忆管理、提示词生成与语义代码搜索，帮助开发者在编程和协作场景中持续深入对话，提升 AI 助手的可用性与上下文连续性。
summary.en: Cunzhi is a cross-platform AI conversation enhancement tool built for MCP clients, designed to prevent assistants from ending interactions too early. It adds intelligent continuation popups, project-level memory management, prompt generation, and semantic code search to keep conversations productive and context-aware. The project is especially useful for developers who rely on AI in coding and collaboration workflows, improving continuity, deeper problem solving, and overall assistant usability without changing the core chat experience.

metadata.name: claude-code-router
metadata.description: One local control plane for every AI agent: route across models, fuse new capabilities, orchestrate tools, and stay fully in control.

summary.zh: Claude Code Router 以 Claude Code 为底座，构建可替换模型与提供商的编码路由层，支持 OpenRouter、Gemini、Ollama 等多源接入。它可按任务类型进行模型路由、动态切换模型，并通过请求响应转换器、插件系统和 GitHub Actions 集成，满足本地开发、自动化编码与 CI 场景中的灵活编排需求。
summary.en: Claude Code Router turns Claude Code into a flexible routing layer for AI coding infrastructure. It lets developers direct different coding tasks to different models or providers, including OpenRouter, Gemini, Ollama, DeepSeek, Volcengine, and SiliconFlow. The project emphasizes practical control: dynamic model switching inside Claude Code, request and response transformation, terminal-based model management, plugin extensibility, and GitHub Actions integration. It is well suited for local development, automated coding workflows, and CI environments where teams want Anthropic’s Claude Code experience without being locked to a single model backend.

metadata.name: mcp-shrimp-task-manager
metadata.description: Shrimp Task Manager is a task tool built for AI Agents, emphasizing chain-of-thought, reflection, and style consistency. It converts natural language into structured dev tasks with dependency tracking and iterative refinement, enabling agent-like developer behavior in reasoning AI systems.

summary.zh: MCP Shrimp Task Manager 是面向 AI 智能体开发的任务管理工具，基于 MCP 将自然语言需求拆解为可执行开发任务，并维护依赖、进度与跨会话上下文。其亮点在于链式推理、反思迭代与风格一致性，适合复杂项目规划、持续编码协作和 AI 辅助软件交付。
summary.en: MCP Shrimp Task Manager is an MCP-based task orchestration tool for AI-driven software development. It turns natural-language requests into structured development tasks with dependency tracking, persistent context, and iterative refinement across sessions. Its key strengths are chain-of-thought support, reflection loops, and style consistency, making it well suited for complex project planning, continuous coding workflows, and agent-like execution in reasoning-oriented AI clients.

metadata.name: ai-goofish
metadata.description: 一个功能强大的闲鱼商品监控系统，能够根据用户设定的关键词自动爬取商品信息，使用AI进行智能分析和筛选，并通过邮件等方式实时通知用户感兴趣的商品。

summary.zh: 该项目是面向闲鱼场景的 AI 商品监控系统，集成 Playwright 爬取、FastAPI 管理界面与 OpenAI 智能分析，可按关键词、价格和卖家条件持续监测商品，并通过邮件实时推送高价值结果。其亮点在于 AI 筛选、Cookie/代理池、频控与日志闭环，适合二手交易线索发现与自动化盯盘。
summary.en: This repository is an AI-powered monitoring system for Xianyu listings, combining Playwright-based scraping, a FastAPI web console, and OpenAI-driven analysis to continuously track products by keyword, price range, and seller filters. It identifies potentially valuable items, stores structured results, and sends real-time notifications by email. Key strengths include AI-assisted filtering, proxy and cookie pool management, adaptive rate limiting, and operational logging, making it well suited for second-hand deal discovery, automated product watching, and lightweight intelligence workflows.

metadata.name: zcf
metadata.description: Zero-Config Code Flow for Claude code & Codex

summary.zh: ZCF 为 Claude Code 与 Codex 提供零配置、一键接入的代码工作流，集成中英双语支持、智能体系统与个性化助手配置，帮助开发者快速搭建统一稳定的 AI 编码环境，显著降低初始化门槛、工具切换成本与团队接入复杂度。
summary.en: ZCF is a zero-config code workflow toolkit for Claude Code and Codex, built to make AI-assisted development usable immediately through one-click setup instead of manual environment wiring. It combines bilingual support, an intelligent agent system, and personalized assistant configuration to standardize coding workflows across developers and teams. Its core value is reducing setup friction, context switching, and onboarding complexity while giving users a faster, more consistent, and more maintainable AI coding environment.

metadata.name: TrendRadar
metadata.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。

summary.zh: TrendRadar 是面向品牌、公关与研究场景的 AI 舆情与趋势监控工具，聚合多平台热点与 RSS 信息流，支持关键词过滤、AI 筛选、翻译、分析简报及多渠道告警。项目以轻量化和快速部署为特点，兼容 Docker 与 MCP，支持本地或云端自持，适合构建可对话、可预警的情报监测体系。
summary.en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool for brand tracking, research, and information intelligence workflows. It aggregates multi-platform trending content and RSS feeds, then applies keyword filtering, AI-based relevance screening, translation, analytical brief generation, and smart alert delivery across channels such as WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Slack, and email. Its main strengths are lightweight architecture, deployment in as little as 30 seconds, Docker support, self-hosted local or cloud operation, and MCP integration for conversational analysis, sentiment insight, and trend forecasting.

metadata.name: ai-goofish-monitor
metadata.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。

summary.zh: 该项目是面向闲鱼商品发现的智能监控平台，结合 Playwright 自动化采集与多模态 AI 分析，实现多任务实时/定时监控、规则筛选和结果研判。系统提供完整 Web 管理后台，支持账号与代理轮换、区域与价格等细粒度过滤，并集成多渠道通知。其亮点在于用自然语言创建监控任务、以 SQLite 统一存储任务与结果，并通过 Docker 快速部署，适合二手交易捡漏、垂直选品和高频行情跟踪场景。
summary.en: This repository is an AI-powered monitoring system for Xianyu that combines Playwright-based browser automation with multimodal model analysis to discover relevant second-hand listings at scale. It supports real-time and scheduled multi-task monitoring, fine-grained filters for price, shipping, posting time, and location, plus account and proxy rotation for resilient execution. A full Web admin UI handles task creation, logs, prompts, and result browsing, while SQLite-backed storage and Docker deployment make the system practical for bargain hunting, niche product sourcing, and continuous market tracking workflows.

metadata.name: NarratoAI
metadata.description: 利用AI大模型，一键解说并剪辑视频； Using AI models to automatically provide commentary and edit videos with a single click.

summary.zh: NarratoAI 是面向影视解说与短剧混剪的一站式 AI 视频生产工具，基于大模型打通文案生成、视频理解、自动剪辑、配音、字幕转录与草稿导出流程。项目支持本地部署和云端托管，兼容多模型与多 TTS 引擎，并持续增强逐帧分析、语音克隆、短剧解说和自动化剪辑能力，适合内容创作者高效完成批量视频制作。
summary.en: NarratoAI is an end-to-end AI video production tool for movie commentary, short-drama narration, and automated remix editing. Built around LLM-driven workflows, it connects script generation, video understanding, auto editing, voice synthesis, subtitle transcription, and draft export in one pipeline. It supports both self-hosted and cloud-based usage, integrates multiple model providers and TTS engines, and keeps expanding capabilities such as frame-level analysis, voice cloning, and short-form video automation for creators who need faster, scalable content production.

metadata.name: Twocast
metadata.description: AI Podcast Generator for bilingual episodes, Multi Languages, Alternative to NotebookLLM；真人对话AI播客生成器，多语言，多音色

summary.zh: Twocast 是面向双人播客场景的 AI 生成平台，支持从主题、链接、文档和列表页一键生成 3 至 9 分钟多语言节目，并输出音频、大纲与脚本。项目集成 Fish Audio、Minimax、Gemini 与 LLM 检索链路，兼顾真人对话感、多音色合成和可部署性，适合内容创作、资讯播报与知识传播。
summary.en: Twocast is an AI podcast generation platform focused on bilingual and multi-language two-host episodes. It can turn topics, links, documents, and list pages into 3 to 9 minute podcasts with audio, outlines, and scripts in one workflow. The project integrates Fish Audio, Minimax, Gemini, and LLM-based search to deliver more natural conversational voices, multiple speaker styles, and flexible deployment. It fits content creation, news-style summarization, knowledge sharing, and automated media production scenarios.

summary.zh: 该项目基于 Cloudflare Workers 与 Hono 构建微信文件传输助手 Web 应用，支持实时聊天、跨设备文件同步、Markdown 渲染与 PWA 离线访问。后端结合 D1 与 R2 实现消息存储和文件管理，采用 JWT 鉴权与边缘计算架构，兼顾低延迟、易部署和多终端使用体验，适合个人或小团队进行轻量级私有化文件传输与消息协作。
summary.en: Wxchat is a WeChat-style web-based file transfer assistant built on Cloudflare Workers and Hono. It provides real-time messaging, cross-device file sharing, Markdown rendering, and PWA offline support in a lightweight full-stack architecture. With D1 for structured data, R2 for object storage, SSE-based sync, and JWT authentication, it targets low-latency private deployment across devices. The project is well suited for personal or small-team scenarios that need simple, browser-based file exchange and message collaboration without relying on heavy frontend frameworks.

metadata.name: AstrBot
metadata.description: AI Agent Assistant & development framework that integrates lots of IM platforms, LLMs, plugins and AI feature, and can be your openclaw alternative. ✨

summary.zh: AstrBot 是面向即时通讯场景的一体化开源 AI 智能体平台与开发框架，集成主流 IM、LLM 与插件生态，支持快速搭建可扩展聊天助手。其亮点在于多平台接入、模块化扩展、稳定会话基础设施，以及兼顾个人部署与团队级开发的工程化能力。
summary.en: AstrBot is an open-source all-in-one AI agent platform and development framework built for conversational assistants on mainstream messaging platforms. It combines IM integration, LLM connectivity, plugin extensibility, and production-oriented chatbot infrastructure in a single stack. Its core value lies in helping individuals and teams quickly build scalable, multi-platform AI assistants with modular features, flexible model support, and an extensible ecosystem. For developers seeking an OpenClaw alternative, AstrBot stands out with pragmatic deployment, strong integration breadth, and a framework-friendly architecture for custom AI workflows.

metadata.name: novel_by_you
metadata.description: a novel program by you

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 React、Vite 与 OpenAI 兼容接口的 AI 交互式小说生成器，支持武侠、科幻、奇幻等多风格创作。用户通过剧情分支推进故事，系统结合结构思考、偏好分析与关键词解析机制，尽量降低大模型格式不稳定带来的影响，适合用于沉浸式叙事创作与轻量化 AI 阅读互动应用。
summary.en: Novel By You is an AI-powered interactive fiction generator built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand, using OpenAI-compatible model endpoints. It lets users choose genres such as wuxia, sci-fi, fantasy, and mystery, then steer the story through branching decisions. A keyword-based response parser replaces strict JSON dependence, improving resilience against unstable model outputs. The app also adds session-level story structure planning and user preference analysis, allowing later plot development to adapt to reader choices. It fits lightweight AI storytelling, interactive reading experiences, and rapid experimentation with narrative generation workflows.

summary.zh: 该仓库公开信息极少，当前仅有“bye~”式 README，未说明功能、技术栈或使用方式。基于现有内容，更像是占位、测试或个人试验仓库，而非可直接复用的完整项目；其核心特征是结构极简、说明缺失，暂无法判断具体应用场景与技术亮点。
summary.en: This repository exposes almost no usable project information. The README only contains a brief “bye~” message, with no description of features, architecture, setup, or technology choices. Based on the current state, it appears more like a placeholder, test repo, or personal experiment than a reusable production project. Its most evident characteristics are minimal structure and missing documentation, which makes the intended use case, technical direction, and implementation highlights impossible to confirm from the available public materials alone.

metadata.name: ioe
metadata.description: One-Stop Retail Inventory Solution

summary.zh: IOE 是面向零售门店与小型仓库的一站式库存管理系统，基于 Django 构建，覆盖商品、库存、盘点、销售、会员与报表分析全流程。其亮点在于实时库存跟踪、低库存预警、多支付收银、会员积分体系及可视化经营报表，支持 SQLite 开箱即用与 Docker 部署。
summary.en: IOE is a Django-based retail inventory management system built for stores, small warehouses, and product-driven businesses. It covers the full operational flow, including product cataloging, stock tracking, stocktaking, sales processing, membership management, and analytics reporting. Key strengths include real-time inventory updates, low-stock alerts, flexible payment support, loyalty points, and visual business dashboards. It is practical to deploy, with SQLite available out of the box and Docker support for production-oriented setups.

metadata.name: One-click-cleaning-of-C-drive
metadata.description: 只需轻松一点，即可安全高效的清理C盘残留和垃圾，并且对电脑毫无危险

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Windows 的开源 C 盘清理工具，基于 Python 提供免安装、一键扫描与安全清理能力，可处理临时文件、浏览器缓存、更新残留和大文件占用。项目强调模拟预览、备份恢复与多重安全检查，适合需要低风险释放系统盘空间的个人用户与运维场景。
summary.en: This repository provides an open-source Windows C drive cleaning tool built with Python, designed to remove temporary files, browser caches, update leftovers, logs, and other disk-consuming residue with minimal user effort. Its main value lies in safe cleanup: simulation mode, backup and restore workflows, and multiple safety checks help prevent accidental deletion of critical system files. It also includes large-file scanning for faster storage diagnosis. The project is well suited for personal PC maintenance and lightweight Windows system administration scenarios where reclaiming disk space safely is the priority.

metadata.name: weekly
metadata.description: 科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布

summary.zh: 该仓库是阮一峰维护的《科技爱好者周刊》开源归档，按周持续整理技术新闻、工具、文章与行业观察，覆盖 AI、编程、互联网商业和工程实践。核心价值在于高频筛选与长期沉淀，适合开发者、产品人和科技从业者快速获取趋势判断、优质资源与话题线索。
summary.en: This repository is the open archive of Ruanyifeng's Weekly for tech enthusiasts, publishing curated weekly issues focused on technology news, tools, articles, and industry commentary. It covers AI, software development, internet business, and engineering practice. Its core value is consistent high-signal curation and long-term accumulation, making it useful for developers, product teams, and tech professionals who need fast access to trends, quality resources, and discussion topics.

metadata.name: RedNote-MCP
metadata.description: 🚀MCP server for accessing RedNote(XiaoHongShu, xhs).

summary.zh: RedNote MCP 是面向小红书内容访问的 MCP 服务，基于 Node.js 与 Playwright 实现登录态持久化、关键词搜索和笔记 URL 抓取。它可接入 Cursor 等支持 MCP 的智能体环境，帮助模型安全调用真实站点内容，适用于内容检索、知识采集与自动化助手集成场景。
summary.en: RedNote MCP is an MCP server for accessing XiaoHongShu (RedNote) content from agent environments such as Cursor. Built with Node.js and Playwright, it supports browser-based login initialization, persistent cookie management, keyword search, and note retrieval by URL. Its main value is turning a consumer web platform into a tool callable through the Model Context Protocol, making it useful for AI assistants, content discovery workflows, knowledge collection, and automation scenarios that require authenticated access to live RedNote data.

metadata.name: LibreTV
metadata.description: 一分钟搭建影视站，支持Vercel/Docker等部署方式

summary.zh: LibreTV 是面向个人部署的轻量级影视搜索与播放平台，聚合多视频源内容，支持免注册访问、跨设备观看与密码保护。项目以原生前端结合 Serverless 代理实现 HLS 播放和接口兼容，可快速部署到 Vercel、Netlify、Cloudflare Pages 或 Docker，适合低门槛搭建私有在线视频站点。
summary.en: LibreTV is a lightweight self-hosted video search and streaming platform for quickly launching a personal online media site. It aggregates content from multiple third-party sources, supports password protection, device-friendly playback, and no-registration access. Built with native web technologies plus serverless proxy capabilities, it handles HLS streaming and Apple CMS V10-compatible APIs.
