The project is designed for fast deployment on Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, or Docker, making it practical for private, low-maintenance video portal setups.

metadata.name: Folo
metadata.description: 🧡 Folo is the AI RSS Reader

summary.zh: Folo 是面向信息订阅与知识获取的 AI RSS 阅读器，支持桌面与移动端分发，帮助用户统一追踪博客、新闻与创作者内容。项目亮点在于将 RSS 聚合、跨平台客户端与 AI 能力结合，提升内容筛选、阅读效率和个性化信息消费体验。
summary.en: Folo is an AI-powered RSS reader built for modern content tracking and knowledge consumption. It helps users follow blogs, news sources, and creators from a unified reading experience across desktop and mobile platforms. Its core value lies in combining RSS aggregation with AI-assisted reading workflows, making information discovery, filtering, and consumption more efficient. With cross-platform distribution and an open-source product approach, Folo stands out as a practical tool for users who want a smarter, centralized way to manage fast-moving content streams.

summary.zh: LLMAI-writer 是面向小说创作的 AI 写作工具，覆盖大纲生成、人物设定、章节创作、分析润色到知识库检索的完整流程。项目支持 GPT、Claude、Gemini、Ollama 等多模型接入，结合上下文感知生成、人物关系图与统计可视化，适合网文作者和长篇内容生产场景。
summary.en: LLMAI-writer is an AI-assisted novel writing tool built for end-to-end long-form fiction creation. It supports outline generation, character design, chapter drafting, revision, knowledge-base retrieval, and story analytics in one workflow. The project integrates multiple LLM providers, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Ollama, and adds context-aware generation, relationship graph visualization, and writing statistics, making it well suited for web fiction authors, independent writers, and structured narrative production.

metadata.name: get_jobs
metadata.description: 💼【AI找工作助手】全平台自动投简历脚本：(boss、前程无忧、猎聘、智联招聘)

summary.zh: 这是一个面向求职场景的自动化投递工具，覆盖 Boss、前程无忧、猎聘、智联等平台，提供图形化配置、智能筛选、黑名单去重与企业微信通知。项目基于 Java/Gradle 与浏览器自动化，并接入大模型生成岗位匹配分析和个性化招呼语，提升海投效率与投递精准度。
summary.en: Get Jobs is a job-application automation assistant for major Chinese recruitment platforms such as Boss, 51Job, Liepin, and Zhilian. It combines a GUI, centralized configuration, browser automation, blacklist deduplication, HR/activity filtering, and WeCom notifications to streamline high-volume resume delivery. Its standout capability is LLM integration for job-match evaluation and personalized greetings, helping users improve targeting accuracy and response rates while reducing repetitive manual work in multi-platform job searches.

metadata.name: JD-AutomatedTools
metadata.description: 👏JD personal order information crawling. | 京东个人订单信息爬取。👏 JD order automation evaluation, are given five-star praise, picture and text. | 京东订单自动化评价，均给予五星好评以及图文。👏 Get cookies after login jd.com. | 登录京东后获取cookie。

summary.zh: 该仓库围绕京东账号操作自动化，整合订单信息抓取与持久化、登录态和 Cookie 管理、订单批量评价等能力。技术亮点在于按子模块拆分流程，覆盖从登录到数据提取再到评价执行的闭环，适用于个人数据整理、自动化测试与电商流程研究。
summary.en: This repository packages several JD.com account automation workflows, including personal order data extraction and persistence, login simulation with cookie management, and batch order review submission. Its main strength is a modular structure that connects authentication, data collection, and automated actions into one end-to-end toolchain. It is most relevant for personal data archiving, automation testing, and research into e-commerce workflow scripting.

metadata.name: ACL4SSR
metadata.description: clashverge Script/ clash ACL/ clash script

summary.zh: 该仓库基于 ACL4SSR 维护定制化 Clash 与 Clash Verge 分流规则，聚焦去广告、GFWList、IPv6 与策略组扩展。核心亮点是提供可直接嵌入 Clash Verge Script 的现成脚本，便于按订阅或全局方式快速实现精细化流量路由与规则增强。
summary.en: This repository is a customized fork of ACL4SSR focused on Clash and Clash Verge traffic-routing rules. It provides ready-to-use rule fragments and scripts for ad blocking, GFWList-based proxying, IPv6 handling, and policy group extension. Its main value is practical deployment: users can directly paste the provided Clash Verge script into global extensions or subscription-specific settings to achieve finer-grained routing control, easier rule customization, and faster setup for proxy management scenarios.

metadata.name: MTranServer
metadata.description: Offline translation model server with low resource consumption, fast speed, and private deployment capability. 低资源占用速度快可私有部署的离线翻译模型服务器

summary.zh: MTranServer 是面向本地与私有化场景的离线翻译模型服务器，主打无显卡运行、低内存占用与毫秒级响应。项目支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Docker 和 npm 部署，兼容 DeepL、DeepLX 及多类翻译插件接口，适合桌面工具、浏览器插件、IDE 注释翻译等高频调用场景。
summary.en: MTranServer is an offline translation model server designed for local and private deployment with very low resource usage and fast response times. It runs without a GPU, delivers roughly millisecond-level inference after model warm-up, and supports major languages. The project provides desktop, Docker, and npm-based deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux, while exposing compatibility endpoints for DeepL, DeepLX, and translation plugins. It is well suited for IDE annotation translation, browser extensions, and other high-frequency translation workflows that need speed, low cost, and data privacy.

metadata.name: deep-research
metadata.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.

summary.zh: Deep Research 是面向深度调研与报告生成的多模型 AI 应用，支持接入主流 LLM、SSE API 与 MCP Server，并整合多种 Web 搜索能力。其亮点在于 2 分钟级研究报告、本地隐私存储、可追溯研究流程、知识库与知识图谱生成，适用于行业分析、资料汇总、问研协作等场景。
summary.en: Deep Research is a multi-LLM application built for fast, in-depth research and report generation. It connects to mainstream large language models, supports SSE APIs and MCP servers, and integrates multiple web search providers to extend model capabilities. Key strengths include near real-time report generation, privacy-first local storage, iterative research workflows, local knowledge base ingestion, and one-click knowledge graph creation. It is well suited for industry analysis, information synthesis, expert research assistance, and collaborative knowledge work across browser and cloud deployment environments.

metadata.name: wasp
metadata.description: The batteries-included full-stack framework for the AI era. Develop JS/TS web apps (React, Node.js, and Prisma) using declarative code that abstracts away complex full-stack features like auth, background jobs, RPC, email sending, end-to-end type safety, single-command deployment, and more.

summary.zh: Wasp 是面向 AI 时代的全栈 Web 框架，以声明式规范整合 React、Node.js 与 Prisma，内置认证、RPC、任务队列、邮件、类型安全与一键部署。它显著减少样板代码，适合快速交付 SaaS、后台系统及 AI 驱动应用，同时保留可控代码与无厂商锁定能力。
summary.en: Wasp is a batteries-included full-stack framework for the AI era, combining React, Node.js, and Prisma through a declarative app specification. It abstracts complex concerns such as authentication, RPC, background jobs, email, end-to-end type safety, and one-command deployment. The result is faster delivery with far less boilerplate, making it well suited for SaaS products, internal tools, and AI-powered web apps. Its opinionated structure also improves AI agent collaboration while preserving code ownership and avoiding vendor lock-in.

metadata.name: flutter_in_action_2nd
metadata.description: 《Flutter实战 第二版》 书稿

summary.zh: 《Flutter实战·第二版》是面向中文开发者的 Flutter 系统教程书稿，覆盖入门、进阶与实战三部分。内容从组件布局、事件动画到网络、国际化和框架原理，结合示例与配套源码，帮助读者建立完整的跨平台应用开发能力，并通过 GitHub App 案例串联真实工程流程。
summary.en: Flutter in Action, 2nd Edition is a Chinese-language draft book that provides a structured, end-to-end guide to Flutter development. It spans beginner, advanced, and project-based sections, covering widgets, layout, event handling, animation, networking, internationalization, and Flutter internals. With practical examples, illustrations, and companion source code, it helps developers build solid cross-platform engineering skills. A simplified GitHub App case study ties the concepts together into a realistic app development workflow.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 FAL.AI 服务的现代 Web 界面，基于 Next.js 14 与 TypeScript 构建，聚焦 API 密钥安全管理、实时调用与流式返回。项目通过服务端代理、加密存储和响应式 UI，降低图像生成等 AI 能力的接入门槛，适合快速部署可用的生成式 AI 前端。
summary.en: This repository delivers a modern web interface for FAL.AI services using Next.js 14 and TypeScript. It focuses on secure API key handling, real-time AI requests, and a responsive user experience for model interaction, especially image generation workflows such as Flux. With a server-side proxy, encrypted client storage, streaming responses, and deployment readiness for Vercel, it lowers the integration cost of building production-friendly generative AI frontends without exposing sensitive credentials in browser code.

metadata.name: cursor-auto-register
metadata.description: cursor-auto-register

summary.zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的 Cursor 账号自动注册与管理工具，结合临时邮箱、数据库持久化、FastAPI 接口和可视化页面，提供账号创建、查询与随机获取能力。其亮点在于将浏览器自动化、邮件转发验证和本地服务封装为可部署的轻量方案，适合学习自动化注册流程、接口封装与账号池管理实现。
summary.en: This repository is a Python-based automation tool for registering and managing Cursor accounts. It integrates temporary email workflows, database persistence, FastAPI endpoints, and a lightweight web UI to support account creation, listing, and random retrieval. Its technical value lies in packaging browser-driven registration, email forwarding verification, and local service orchestration into a deployable solution, making it useful for studying automation pipelines, API wrapping, and account pool management patterns.

metadata.name: LuminaBrush
metadata.description: Illumination Drawing Tools for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

summary.zh: LuminaBrush 是面向文生图扩散模型的交互式光照绘制工具，基于 Flux 采用“均匀光照还原 + 涂鸦控光生成”两阶段框架。它将复杂重光照任务拆解为更稳定的学习流程，既支持用户用笔触编辑人物与场景光效，也可独立用于图像去复杂光照与统一打光预处理。
summary.en: LuminaBrush is an interactive illumination editing tool for text-to-image diffusion workflows, currently built on Flux. It uses a two-stage pipeline: first converting images into a uniformly lit representation, then generating controllable lighting effects from user scribbles. This decomposition makes relighting easier to learn and more stable than a single-stage approach. It is suited for portrait and scene light painting, creative post-processing, and image delighting or uniform-light normalization as a standalone preprocessing capability.

metadata.name: chinese-independent-developer
metadata.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么

summary.zh: 该仓库聚合中国独立开发者已上线或开发中的网站与 App 项目，覆盖 AI 创作、效率工具、内容服务等方向。其核心价值在于展示真实产品形态与创业趋势，帮助开发者发现选题、观察市场，并通过统一收录与贡献机制持续扩展社区项目样本。
summary.en: This repository curates websites and apps built by Chinese indie developers, spanning AI creation, productivity tools, consumer services, and niche products. Its value lies in making real-world side projects and launched products visible, so builders can study market direction, product positioning, and execution patterns. With clear submission rules and category structure, it serves as an evolving community index for discovering trends, inspirations, and practical examples of independent product building in China.

metadata.name: DiffRhythm
metadata.description: Di♪♪Rhythm: Blazingly Fast and Embarrassingly Simple End-to-End Full-Length Song Generation with Latent Diffusion

summary.zh: DiffRhythm 是首个开源、基于潜空间扩散的全曲音乐生成模型，可端到端生成完整歌曲，并支持文本风格提示、纯音乐创作、续写与编辑。项目强调生成速度快、结构控制强，显著改善重复与遗漏问题，适用于 AI 作曲、音乐原型设计与生成式音频研究。
summary.en: DiffRhythm is the first open-source diffusion-based music generation model capable of end-to-end full-length song creation. Built on latent diffusion, it supports text-to-music prompting, instrumental generation, song continuation, and editing while emphasizing fast inference and simpler modeling. Recent updates improve audio quality, arrangement richness, and reduce repetition or omission issues. It is well suited for AI composition, music prototyping, creative production workflows, and research on controllable generative audio systems.

metadata.name: vue-idle-xiuxian
metadata.description: 修仙放置游戏: 我的放置仙途

summary.zh: 《我的放置仙途》是一款基于 Vue 3 生态构建的修仙题材放置游戏，覆盖角色、奇遇、探索、背包、成就、灵宠、装备、炼丹与抽奖等完整成长链路。项目采用 Vite、Pinia 与 Naive UI，兼顾开发效率、状态管理与界面交互，并支持 NPM 与 Docker Compose 快速部署，适合独立游戏前端开发、二创扩展与轻量化运营。
summary.en: "My Idle Immortal Path" is an idle cultivation game built on the Vue 3 ecosystem, featuring a complete progression loop across character growth, random events, exploration, inventory, achievements, pets, equipment, alchemy, and gacha mechanics. It uses Vite for fast builds, Pinia for structured state management, and Naive UI for interface delivery. With both NPM and Docker Compose deployment options, the project is well suited for indie web game development, feature extension, and lightweight live operations.

metadata.name: tuboshu
metadata.description: Transform Your Favorite Websites into Seamless Desktop Experiences✨!   把常用的网站集合到一个桌面程序里。

summary.zh: Tuboshu 是一款基于 Electron 的开源网页转桌面应用工具，可将常用网站快速封装为独立应用，并支持多账号隔离、全局快捷键呼出、窗口与图标自定义、JS 注入及本地配置存储。它适合把 AI、设计、运营、协作等高频网页工具集中到统一桌面入口，兼顾效率、便携打包与跨平台部署能力。
summary.en: Tuboshu is an open-source Electron tool that turns frequently used websites into standalone desktop apps with minimal setup. It supports multi-account isolation, global hotkeys for fast show and hide, custom window size and icons, JavaScript injection, and local-only configuration storage for privacy. The project is well suited for consolidating AI tools, design platforms, collaboration services, and operational dashboards into a unified desktop workspace, while also offering executable packaging for Windows, macOS, and Linux with a strong emphasis on convenience, customization, and cross-platform usability.

metadata.name: bilive
metadata.description: 极快的B站直播录制、自动切片、自动渲染弹幕以及字幕并投稿至B站，综合多种模态模型，兼容超低配置机器。Extremely fast live recording, automatic slicing, rendering, uploading and Integrating MLLMs. Compatible with low configurations machines.

summary.zh: bilive 是面向 B 站直播场景的自动化录播与二创引擎，覆盖监听录制、弹幕渲染、字幕识别、精彩切片、封面生成与自动投稿全流程。项目以流水线处理提升时效，支持多房间、x64/arm64 与无 GPU 低配机器，并结合 Whisper 与多模态大模型生成标题、内容和封面，适合长期无人值守录播运营。
summary.en: bilive is an automation engine for Bilibili live-stream recording and post-processing, covering continuous capture, danmaku rendering, speech-to-subtitle transcription, highlight slicing, cover generation, and auto-upload. Its pipeline-based design keeps turnaround fast, while support for multi-room recording, x64/arm64, and GPU-free low-spec machines makes it practical for unattended operation. By combining Whisper and multimodal LLMs, it can generate clip titles, descriptions, and covers for scalable livestream archival and republishing workflows.

metadata.name: Relive
metadata.description: 直播实时切片工具。基于 PyQt6 + mpv + FFmpeg，支持直播预览、弹幕、时移回看、片段导出。

summary.zh: ReLive 是面向斗鱼、虎牙、B站与抖音的直播实时切片与时移回看工具，结合 PyQt6 图形界面、mpv 低延迟播放与 FFmpeg HLS 录制，实现直播预览、DVR 缓存、弹幕采集回放和片段导出一体化。其亮点在于自动重连、弹幕 NDJSON 持久化、ASS 渲染导出，以及基于 Go 的高实时弹幕采集架构。
summary.en: ReLive is a live-stream DVR and clipping tool for Douyu, Huya, Bilibili, and Douyin. Built with PyQt6, mpv, and FFmpeg, it combines low-latency live preview, adjustable time-shift playback, danmaku capture, and segment export in one desktop workflow. Its main strengths are resilient HLS recording with auto-reconnect, synchronized danmaku replay and density visualization, NDJSON persistence, ASS subtitle export, and a Go-based real-time comment collector that improves responsiveness for supported platforms.

metadata.name: reverse-skill
metadata.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端

summary.zh: 该仓库面向逆向、渗透测试、安全分析与 CTF 场景，提供面向 AI 代码助手的技能路由包。它通过自动识别操作系统、刷新本地工具索引、加载规则链和按需自举工具链，让 Claude Code、Cursor、Cline 等客户端可直接进入安全任务流。亮点在于 AI 自动路由、跨平台部署、工具编排与经验库持续进化，降低环境配置和任务切换成本。
summary.en: This repository is a skill-routing pack for AI coding agents focused on reverse engineering, penetration testing, security analysis, and CTF workflows. It detects the host platform, refreshes a local tool index, loads routing rules, and bootstraps the required toolchain on demand, enabling clients like Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, and Kiro to enter security tasks with minimal manual setup. Its main strengths are AI-driven task routing, cross-platform orchestration, on-demand environment preparation, and an evolving experience base that reduces setup friction and improves operational consistency.

metadata.name: MediaCrawler
metadata.description: MediaCrawler is a powerful web scraper for self-media platforms. Easily collect and analyze content to enhance your digital strategy. 🌐🕷️

summary.zh: MediaCrawler 是面向自媒体与社区平台的数据采集工具，覆盖小红书、抖音、快手、B站、微博、贴吧、知乎，支持抓取笔记、帖子、视频评论等内容，便于舆情分析、竞品研究与内容运营决策，亮点在于多平台统一采集与社媒洞察场景适配。
summary.en: MediaCrawler is a Python-based web scraping tool built for social media and community platforms. It supports data collection across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Weibo, Baidu Tieba, and Zhihu, covering notes, posts, videos, comments, and replies. Its core value lies in unifying multi-platform content acquisition for social listening, competitor monitoring, audience research, and digital content strategy. The main technical highlight is its broad platform coverage and practical focus on collecting user-generated content for downstream analysis and operational insight.

metadata.name: hermes-studio
metadata.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics

summary.zh: Hermes Studio 是面向 Hermes Agent 的本地优先控制台，集成网页控制台、桌面应用与本地运行时，支持多平台 AI 对话、会话管理、定时任务和使用分析。其亮点在于统一管理模型、配置、插件与平台通道，并提供文件浏览、终端、编码代理和本地 SQLite 会话存储，适合个人与团队构建私有化智能体工作台。
summary.en: Hermes Studio is a local-first control plane for Hermes Agent, combining a web dashboard, desktop app, and local runtime into one workspace. It supports multi-platform AI chat, persistent session management, scheduled automation, and usage analytics. Key strengths include unified management of models, profiles, plugins, and channels, plus built-in file browsing, terminal access, coding-agent runners, and SQLite-backed local sessions for private, cross-platform agent operations.

metadata.name: ai-toolbox
metadata.description: Personal AI Toolbox

summary.zh: AI Toolbox 是面向开发者的跨平台桌面应用，集中管理 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 AI 编程助手配置，并统一处理 MCP、Skills、WSL 同步、备份与托盘切换。基于 Tauri、React 和 SurrealDB，兼顾轻量、本地化与多端部署效率。
summary.en: AI Toolbox is a cross-platform desktop app for developers to centrally manage configurations for AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It also unifies MCP server management, Skills installation, WSL synchronization, backups, and tray-based quick switching. Built with Tauri, React, TypeScript, and SurrealDB, it emphasizes lightweight local deployment, visual configuration workflows, and efficient multi-environment operations across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

metadata.name: skills-manager
metadata.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and more.

summary.zh: Skills Manager 是一款面向 AI 编码助手生态的轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、安装、同步与组织跨工具技能。它支持 Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Claude Code 等 15+ 工具，提供中心技能库、预设、全局/项目/链接工作区、批量操作与市场搜索，并通过符号链接或复制实现多工具一键同步，适合个人开发者和团队提升技能复用与协作效率。
summary.en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop application for centrally managing, organizing, and syncing AI agent skills across more than 15 coding tools, including Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Claude Code. It combines a unified skill library, marketplace discovery, AI-powered search, presets, and global, project, and linked workspaces into one workflow. With one-click sync via symlink or copy, batch operations, tagging, update tracking, and bidirectional project sync, it helps developers and teams reuse skills consistently and keep multi-tool AI coding environments aligned.

metadata.name: CodexBar
metadata.description: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.

summary.zh: CodexBar 是面向 macOS 的轻量菜单栏工具，聚合 Codex、Claude、Cursor 等多家 AI 编码服务的额度、重置倒计时、状态与费用信息。它复用本地登录态、Cookie、OAuth 与 API Key，无需单独登录，兼顾隐私、低打扰体验与多提供商统一监控。
summary.en: CodexBar is a lightweight macOS menu bar app that surfaces usage limits, reset timers, service status, credits, and spending across many AI coding providers such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and Copilot. It reuses existing local sessions, browser cookies, OAuth flows, app files, and API keys instead of requiring separate logins, making it privacy-friendly and low friction. Its key value is unified, always-visible operational awareness for developers who rely on multiple AI coding tools and need to plan around rate limits, billing windows, and outages.

metadata.name: IDA-NO-MCP
metadata.description: Say goodbye to the complex, verbose, and laggy interaction mode of IDA Pro MCP

summary.zh: IDA NO MCP 是面向 IDA Pro 的轻量导出插件，解决传统 MCP 交互复杂、卡顿与配置繁琐问题。它将反编译代码、反汇编回退、调用关系、字符串、导入导出表及内存 hexdump 批量导出为 AI IDE 易消费的文本资产，便于在 Cursor、Claude Code 等环境中进行 AI 辅助逆向、索引分析与大函数切片处理，尤其强化了 macOS 体验。
summary.en: IDA NO MCP is a lightweight IDA Pro export plugin built to replace slow, verbose, and configuration-heavy MCP-based workflows. It exports decompiled C code, disassembly fallbacks, call graphs, strings, import/export tables, and memory hexdumps into AI-friendly text assets that work directly with IDEs like Cursor and Claude Code. This enables faster AI-assisted reverse engineering, large-function chunking, and context-rich binary analysis, with stability fixes and specific optimization for macOS.

metadata.name: battery
metadata.description: CLI/GUI for managing the battery charging status for Apple silicon (M1, M2, M3) Macs

summary.zh: Battery 是面向 Apple Silicon Mac 的电池充电管理工具，提供 CLI 与托盘 GUI，通过调用 SMC 控制充电开关，将长期插电设备维持在 80% 或自定义区间。它支持重启后持续生效、安装简单，适合办公桌面常驻使用场景，可有效降低高电量久置带来的电池老化风险。
summary.en: Battery is a battery charge management tool for Apple Silicon Macs, offering both a CLI and a tray-based GUI. By controlling charging through SMC, it can keep a MacBook at 80% or within a custom range, making it ideal for users who keep their laptops plugged in for long periods. It supports persistent settings across reboots, simple installation via Homebrew or DMG, and helps reduce battery wear caused by staying at high charge levels continuously.

metadata.name: tickflow-stock-panel
metadata.description: 自托管、零运维的 A 股「选股 + 监控 + 回测」量化工作台 | 基于 TickFlow 数据源  | LLM能力驱使策略定制+个股分析+复盘 | 自由接入第三方数据源与个性化扩展数据 | 个人开源 ,非TickFlow官方项目

summary.zh: TickFlow Stock Panel 是面向 A 股个人投资者与量化爱好者的自托管工作台，围绕选股、监控、回测构建一体化分析流程。项目以 TickFlow 数据为基础，采用 Python + React 架构，借助 Polars 向量化指标与策略引擎提升扫描效率，并引入 LLM 生成策略、个股分析与复盘能力，同时支持接入第三方扩展数据，兼顾开箱即用与个性化扩展。
summary.en: TickFlow Stock Panel is a self-hosted quantitative workstation for China A-share investors and retail quants, combining stock screening, monitoring, and backtesting in one workflow. Built on TickFlow data with a Python and React stack, it uses a Polars-based vectorized indicator and strategy engine to scan the full market efficiently. The project also adds LLM-driven strategy generation, stock analysis, and review capabilities, while allowing third-party data integration for personalized signals, making it practical for both turnkey use and custom quantitative extensions.

metadata.name: wx-cli
metadata.description: WeChat local data CLI with daemon architecture

summary.zh: wx-cli 是一款面向本地微信数据的跨平台命令行工具，采用 Rust 单二进制与后台 daemon 架构，支持会话、聊天记录、联系人、群信息、收藏和统计查询。其核心优势是本地实时解密与缓存复用，响应快、无需上传数据，并以结构化结果天然适配 Claude、Cursor、Codex 等 AI Agent 自动消费。
summary.en: wx-cli is a cross-platform command-line tool for querying local WeChat data with a Rust single-binary design and daemon-based architecture. It supports sessions, chat history, contacts, group metadata, favorites, statistics, and search. Its main strengths are real-time local decryption, persistent cache reuse for millisecond-level responses, and AI-friendly structured outputs that integrate cleanly with agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

metadata.name: wechat-selkies
metadata.description: 基于Selkies的Linux网页版微信/QQ/Telegram，支持本地中文输入法，支持三方应用，支持AMD64和ARM64。

summary.zh: 该项目将 Linux 版微信、QQ 与 Telegram 封装进 Docker，并借助 Selkies WebRTC 实现浏览器远程访问。它支持本地中文输入法、文件传输、图片复制、数据持久化及 GPU 加速，兼容 AMD64/ARM64，适合云主机、NAS 与远程办公场景下的即时通信与桌面应用接入。
summary.en: This project packages Linux versions of WeChat, QQ, and Telegram into Docker containers and exposes them through the browser with Selkies WebRTC streaming. It enables remote messaging without installing native clients locally, while preserving Chinese input method support, file transfer, image copy, persistent data storage, and optional GPU acceleration. With AMD64 and ARM64 compatibility plus integration for third-party desktop apps, it fits cloud servers, NAS deployments, and remote work environments that need browser-based access to Linux communication tools.

metadata.name: infiplot
metadata.description: InfiPlot is the world's first interactive plot game that AI generates all text and images in real-time. InfiPlot是全球首个在游玩过程中由 AI 实时生成全部图文内容的互动剧情游戏

summary.zh: InfiPlot 是一款由 AI 在游玩过程中实时生成文本、图像与配音的互动剧情游戏。它通过编剧、角色设计、场景布置和画家等多智能体协作，动态构建个性化剧情、角色与画面，并支持预测式生成、点击探索和多种艺术风格，适合沉浸式叙事、角色扮演与 AI 游戏创作探索。
summary.en: InfiPlot is an interactive story game where AI generates all text, images, and voice content in real time during gameplay. Instead of relying on predefined plots or characters, it uses a multi-agent architecture with dedicated roles such as writer, character designer, scene designer, and artist to create personalized narratives on demand. Key features include predictive generation for smooth scene transitions, vision-based click exploration, AI voice acting, and flexible visual styles, making it a strong experiment in generative AI gaming and immersive storytelling.

metadata.name: mediago
metadata.description: Download videos from 90+ Chinese educational platforms. Single binary, yt-dlp style.

summary.zh: MediaGo 是面向中文互联网的命令行媒体下载器，支持 92 个站点和 103 个提取器，重点覆盖 B 站、慕课、超星等教育与视频平台。项目采用 Go 编写，提供单二进制分发，具备 yt-dlp 式用法，支持 Cookie 登录、格式选择、课程/播放列表批量下载、代理、并发分片和 JSON 信息导出。
summary.en: MediaGo is a command-line media downloader built for the Chinese internet, supporting 92 platforms and 103 extractors with strong coverage of educational and video sites such as Bilibili, Chaoxing, iCourse163, Douyin, and CCTV. Written in Go and distributed as a single binary, it offers a yt-dlp-like workflow with cookie authentication, browser cookie import, format selection, playlist/course downloading, proxy support, concurrent fragment downloads, JSON metadata output, subtitles, and optional ffmpeg-based HLS/DASH merging.

metadata.name: graphify
metadata.description: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.

summary.zh: Graphify 是面向 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的知识图谱技能，可将代码、SQL 架构、脚本、文档、论文及多媒体统一映射为可查询图谱，帮助开发者理解项目依赖、数据库与基础设施关系，替代低效 grep。
summary.en: Graphify is an AI coding-assistant skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and similar tools. It turns an entire project folder—including application code, SQL schemas, R or shell scripts, documentation, papers, images, and videos—into a queryable knowledge graph. By connecting code, database structure, and infrastructure in one graph, it helps developers explore dependencies, understand system architecture, and retrieve project knowledge more effectively than searching files with grep.

metadata.name: opentalking
metadata.description: OpenTalking: An industrial-grade open-source AI digital human framework that supports real-time conversation, private deployment, and pluggable models.

summary.zh: OpenTalking 是面向数字人的工业级开源框架，打通 WebUI、会话状态、LLM、STT/TTS、字幕事件与 WebRTC 音视频播放链路，支持实时对话、视频生成与克隆。其亮点在于模型后端可插拔、支持私有化部署，并兼容本地与远程推理工作流。
summary.en: OpenTalking is an industrial-grade open-source framework for real-time AI digital humans. It integrates WebUI, session orchestration, LLM, STT/TTS, subtitle events, and WebRTC audio-video playback into a unified pipeline for conversational avatars, video generation, and video cloning. Its main strengths are pluggable model backends, support for both local and remote inference workflows, and private deployment options, making it practical for production scenarios such as customer service, healthcare guidance, and live commerce.

metadata.name: creatorhub
metadata.description: 多平台内容监控·采集·搬运 —— 纯 Python(FastAPI + Playwright),一个 Web 面板管起抖音 / 小红书 / 快手

summary.zh: CreatorHub 是面向抖音、小红书、快手的多平台内容监控与搬运系统，基于 FastAPI + Playwright 以真实浏览器拦截接口响应，绕开手写签名难题。它统一管理账号、代理、作品、评论、私信与发布流程，适合内容运营、舆情跟踪和批量采集分发场景。
summary.en: CreatorHub is a Python-based multi-platform content monitoring and reposting system for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Kuaishou. Built with FastAPI and Playwright, it uses real browser sessions to capture platform API responses, avoiding brittle handwritten request signing. The project unifies account management, proxy isolation, post and comment monitoring, downloading, messaging, and publishing in one web console, making it well suited for creator operations, social media tracking, and large-scale content collection workflows.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Browser automation CLI built for AI agents. Break through anti-bot walls, hand off to humans across platforms when stuck. Parallel multi-task execution, independent multi-session operation, isolated multi-account browsing.

summary.zh: BrowserAct Skills 是面向 AI 智能体的浏览器自动化 CLI，聚焦反爬突破、多人机协同与多会话隔离。它通过指纹伪装、TLS/代理轮换、验证码处理和远程人工接管，帮助智能体完成高阻力网页任务；同时支持并行执行、多账号独立浏览及面向 LLM 的低 token 交互输出，适合自动化采集、网页操作与代理型工作流。
summary.en: BrowserAct Skills is a browser automation CLI built for AI agents, focused on bypassing anti-bot defenses, enabling seamless human handoff, and isolating concurrent browser sessions. It combines stealth fingerprinting, TLS and proxy rotation, CAPTCHA solving, and remote assistance to handle high-friction web tasks. With parallel execution, multi-account isolation, and token-efficient indexed outputs designed for LLM reasoning, it fits agentic automation, web operations, and large-scale browser task orchestration.

metadata.name: gzh-design-skill
metadata.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AI Agent 的公众号排版技能库，可将 Markdown 一键转换为适配微信编辑器的内联 HTML。项目提供 6 套成熟主题和主题生成器，支持代码块、图片、GIF、目录、章节编号与关键词标记，并通过组件级与成品级双重校验，确保粘贴后样式稳定、不掉格式，适合公众号长文、教程、评测与报告类内容生产。
summary.en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent-oriented formatting skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready inline HTML for the WeChat Official Account editor. It ships with six production-ready themes, a theme generator, and strong support for code blocks, images, GIFs, tables of contents, section numbering, and keyword emphasis. Its main technical strength is deterministic compatibility: all styles are inlined and validated through both component-level and final-output checks, reducing formatting loss after paste. It is well suited for long-form articles, tutorials, reviews, reports, and other content-heavy publishing workflows.

metadata.name: CodeStable
metadata.description: CodeStable 是一套面向严肃软件工程、坚持人在环的 AI 编码工作流。它不以编排 Agent 为中心，而是组织需求、架构、特性、问题与历史决策，让 Codex 和 Claude 驱动的开发过程可控、可追溯、可持续演进。

summary.zh: CodeStable 是面向长期迭代软件项目的 AI 编码工作流，以“人在环”为核心，围绕需求、架构、特性、缺陷与决策组织工程上下文，而非编排多 Agent 协作。它通过可读的项目内文件树沉淀状态，配合 Codex、Claude 与 skills 插件体系，实现可控、可追溯、可持续演进的开发流程，并强调 skill 的 build-evaluate 工程闭环，适合严肃软件工程与复杂项目维护。
summary.en: CodeStable is an AI coding workflow for serious, long-lived software projects, built around a human-in-the-loop model rather than multi-agent orchestration. It organizes requirements, architecture, features, issues, and historical decisions as durable engineering context inside a readable project file tree, making AI-assisted development more controllable, traceable, and maintainable. With Codex, Claude, and a skills-based plugin runtime, it supports disciplined implementation workflows and emphasizes reproducible build-evaluate loops for iterating skills as engineering assets.

metadata.name: cc-connect
metadata.description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.

summary.zh: cc-connect 将本地 AI 编程助手接入飞书、Slack、Telegram 等消息平台，让开发者无需公网 IP 也能远程对话、执行命令、查看和修改本地项目。项目同时兼容多种主流 coding agent，覆盖个人开发、团队协作与运维自动化场景，亮点在于多平台桥接、低部署门槛与本地工作流延伸能力。
summary.en: cc-connect bridges local AI coding agents to messaging platforms such as Lark, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WeChat Work, letting developers chat with and operate their local coding assistant remotely without requiring a public IP in most cases. It supports multiple mainstream coding agents, making it useful for personal development, team collaboration, and automation workflows. Its main strengths are multi-platform integration, lightweight deployment, and secure extension of local development workflows into everyday chat tools.

metadata.name: CodexPlusPlus
metadata.description: An enhanced tool for CodexApp, striving to make Codex better to use and more comfortable 一个CodexApp的增强工具，努力让Codex变得更好用更舒服

summary.zh: Codex++ 是面向 Codex/ChatGPT 桌面端的增强型外部启动与管理工具，基于 Rust 与 Tauri，通过 CDP 和本地辅助服务实现供应商切换、协议转换、会话管理和界面增强。它避免修改官方安装文件，兼顾跨平台部署、安全性与可维护性，适合高频 AI 编程与多模型协作场景。
summary.en: Codex++ is an external launcher and management companion for the OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT desktop apps. Built with Rust and Tauri, it uses the Chromium DevTools Protocol plus local helper services to provide provider switching, protocol translation, session management, and UI enhancements. It improves daily AI coding workflows without patching the official app package, making it a practical cross-platform tool for safer maintenance, multi-model access, and a more comfortable desktop experience.

metadata.name: Chat2API-web
metadata.description: Chat2API enables zero-cost access to leading AI models by leveraging official web UIs. It supports providers such as DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and Z.ai, and seamlessly integrates with tools like openlcaw, Cline, and Roo-Code.

summary.zh: Chat2API Web 是面向多模型接入与统一运维的纯 Web 网关，通过复用官方网页端能力，以 OpenAI 兼容接口低成本接入 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen 等模型。项目基于 Node.js、React、TypeScript，提供负载均衡、上下文压缩、函数调用、会话清理与监控面板，适合私有部署和多账号管理。
summary.en: Chat2API Web is a browser-based unified gateway for accessing major AI models through their official web interfaces at near-zero cost. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible API so existing clients can work without modification, while supporting providers such as DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and more. Built with Node.js, React, and TypeScript, it adds practical operations features including model mapping, multi-account load balancing, context compression, function calling, session cleanup, request logging, and real-time monitoring for self-hosted deployments.

metadata.name: Chat2API
metadata.description: Chat2API enables zero-cost access to leading AI models by leveraging official web UIs. It supports providers such as DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and Z.ai, and seamlessly integrates with tools like openlcaw, Cline, and Roo-Code.

summary.zh: Chat2API 是一款跨平台 AI 接口代理与统一管理工具，通过复用官方网页端能力，将 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen 等模型转换为 OpenAI 兼容接口。其亮点在于多供应商接入、上下文管理、函数调用映射、模型路由与实时监控，适合本地开发、代理聚合和多模型工作流集成。
summary.en: Chat2API is a cross-platform AI gateway and management tool that turns official web interfaces from providers like DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, and others into OpenAI-compatible APIs. It is designed for developers who need a low-cost unified access layer across multiple models and accounts. Key strengths include provider aggregation, context window management, function-calling via prompt engineering, flexible model mapping and routing, custom request parameters, and built-in monitoring for traffic, tokens, logs, and operational status.

metadata.name: Codex-Dream-Skin
metadata.description: Codex Dream Skin

summary.zh: Codex Dream Skin 是面向 Codex 桌面端的外部换肤工具，通过本机回环 CDP 注入为侧栏、输入框等原生界面叠加主题背景，支持 macOS 与 Windows，一键安装、恢复，无需修改官方安装包或签名，兼顾氛围化定制与相对安全性。
summary.en: Codex Dream Skin is an external theming tool for the Codex desktop app. It injects visual customization through a local loopback CDP workflow, allowing users to replace backgrounds while keeping native interactive UI elements such as sidebars, suggestion cards, project pickers, and input fields intact. The project supports both macOS and Windows with ready-to-run scripts, provides restore capability, and avoids modifying official binaries, app bundles, signatures, or WindowsApps files. Its main value is personalized desktop styling with a relatively safer, non-invasive integration approach.
